I serve God first

| |
---
| | | | [](http://links.gopwinning.org/u/click?_t=ea36c899de41479ca8c7218c6a20a10b&_m=dacddd80c3cf4612a5a3008c9c3a238c&_e=WjonvfjMrVLc-oZPZk1EBYA7Yjp-jdIsHV1FGXmNrywVftITfWhJ77-PS8KB1sxtku86Q2cBYBQ3iYfYRZEmRgyxDUnrwwnG_FYFgRJFXWNa5Rs9bNFIEPNGL51RSt1gGu6KZD-45gwahQ_cymHZTjD86H9tjs4OmX9by3jDqNem0gWQi2G0ES7u01mxecD2_k-XqcftIp7nfKqzu17SXmDXD-l_vSzyKcWNzzxWgdR8wd_HkWxqV3qE4WawPmShQ1WrAirWQguLt5cICGS3biMpiCbdHnaxWQLUL5YxjQzUdPUTIjEezgi1iMZ2rwbK6ydUy81ZkdRX5pBOIkfLiuU6P0flAvpAHdawypvIn5LbQlaiGJXNbRpRVUCotUJ70lrhOUc4dfxpGDv2jPy1Y5XvtzUVUH87kyKROb5r8Adc0yIqysI576qFJQRsQse0p_lyJLthiBippBOfvH0WIGeKm5e42p_1GaOowGSCffCLJsmcdUq7vyzjYW6r00JaazaUlcJnCXyioubL88Y1TA%3D%3D)
---

Friend,

I'm the product of an unplanned pregnancy.

Born to two teenage parents, every statistic and societal roadblock indicated that I was destined for a life of hardship.

But my parents didn't buy into any of that.

I may have been unplanned, but that did not mean I was unwanted.

Soon after me, three more kids came. And what began as a teenage love story quickly became a family of six. My dad went to work and did whatever he needed to do to make ends meet for our family. That meant putting his life on the line to serve his community in the local fire department.

All my life, I wanted to be like my dad, and there was nothing I dreamed of more than becoming a firefighter just like him.

But on a fateful day in September of 1984, all of that changed.

My dad and his battalion responded to a call that would change all of our lives forever.

By the grace of God my dad made it out of that building alive, but not unscathed. Eighty percent of his body was covered in burns.

From then on, the hardest working man that I knew would not be able to work as a fireman another day of his life. And as the oldest of four kids, it was up to me to step in and help fill the void in our young family.

We're all a product of our experiences, and that moment defined who I am.

My dream of becoming a firefighter like my dad was now discouraged, and I had effectively been launched into the role of a pseudo-parent to my younger siblings overnight.

**Being raised in a Christian household without a lot of means, we put our head down for two reasons:

1\. To pray to God
2\. To get to work**

So, at 12 years old, I picked myself up by my bootstraps and did just that -- got to work.

And to be quite honest, I haven't really picked my head back up since.

From a young boy trying to help his parents make ends meet, to a law student, to a husband and father, and eventually to Speaker of the House, the only thing I have ever been focused on is getting the job done.

My wife might call me a workaholic, but in my mind, I am a man who is focused on the task at hand, and completing a mission.

**[Right now, my mission is to ensure that my kids have the same opportunity to make a life for themselves and achieve their goals like I did.](http://links.gopwinning.org/u/click?_t=ea36c899de41479ca8c7218c6a20a10b&_m=dacddd80c3cf4612a5a3008c9c3a238c&_e=WjonvfjMrVLc-oZPZk1EBYA7Yjp-jdIsHV1FGXmNrywVftITfWhJ77-PS8KB1sxtku86Q2cBYBQ3iYfYRZEmRgyxDUnrwwnG_FYFgRJFXWNa5Rs9bNFIEPNGL51RSt1gGu6KZD-45gwahQ_cymHZTjD86H9tjs4OmX9by3jDqNem0gWQi2G0ES7u01mxecD2_k-XqcftIp7nfKqzu17SXmDXD-l_vSzyKcWNzzxWgdR8wd_HkWxqV3qE4WawPmShQ1WrAirWQguLt5cICGS3biMpiCbdHnaxWQLUL5YxjQzUdPUTIjEezgi1iMZ2rwbK6ydUy81ZkdRX5pBOIkfLiuU6P0flAvpAHdawypvIn5LbQlaiGJXNbRpRVUCotUJ7VNZeJBmfMxg3lvaRu4Mie53C_HDk1SKOTbxxGDu1SPC1_qeww-_llMFRonBtyFLO-Drin410yZ0SG5uBm_G1nbAn4COxyE0acDWbo4nBw9NDwzYVzbNVpDs9ZVxmvn1ARzJRMJbk11prOMlLzSU6yw%3D%3D "Right now, my mission is to ensure that my kids have the same opportunity to make a life for themselves and achieve their goals like I did. ")**

And that means being the kind of conservative, Christian leader in Washington, D.C. that my dad would be proud of.

That alone puts you at odds with the D.C. Establishment, by the way.

I'm not interested in the cocktail parties, or rubbing elbows with different special interest groups.

The Washington Elite and their allies in the mainstream media can cast judgment all they want. That doesn't bother me.

Because at the end of the day, I know that I serve an audience of one -- and that I am doing all that I can with the blessings given to me, and the faith entrusted to me, to glorify God.

**[So, now that you know just a little bit more about me, where I come from, and what keeps me going, I humbly ask if you are willing to stand alongside me in this fight?](http://links.gopwinning.org/u/click?_t=ea36c899de41479ca8c7218c6a20a10b&_m=dacddd80c3cf4612a5a3008c9c3a238c&_e=WjonvfjMrVLc-oZPZk1EBYA7Yjp-jdIsHV1FGXmNrywVftITfWhJ77-PS8KB1sxtku86Q2cBYBQ3iYfYRZEmRgyxDUnrwwnG_FYFgRJFXWNa5Rs9bNFIEPNGL51RSt1gGu6KZD-45gwahQ_cymHZTjD86H9tjs4OmX9by3jDqNem0gWQi2G0ES7u01mxecD2_k-XqcftIp7nfKqzu17SXmDXD-l_vSzyKcWNzzxWgdR8wd_HkWxqV3qE4WawPmShQ1WrAirWQguLt5cICGS3biMpiCbdHnaxWQLUL5YxjQzUdPUTIjEezgi1iMZ2rwbK6ydUy81ZkdRX5pBOIkfLiuU6P0flAvpAHdawypvIn5LbQlaiGJXNbRpRVUCotUJ7HkX3RUT7XJAJ42qd4WtK-2hhrHVurDZieZO18HBIJhKFS9k87ZZYN0jvTpbLIlXDHrJ61vDM6lw9U5RG-yLNb9NuErCkseqm1bytJSfePQH6fpt8THb7PKhJIHxgjnVc-98jDtxnI8VFyzBmzsBCeQ%3D%3D "So, now that you know just a little bit more about me, where I come from, and what keeps me going, I humbly ask if you are willing to stand alongside me in this fight? ")**

Thank you for your time and support,

From a young boy trying to help his parents make ends meet, to a law student, to a husband and father, and eventually to Speaker of the House, the only thing I have ever been focused on is getting the job done. My wife might call me a workaholic, but in my mind, I am a man who is focused on the task at hand, and completing a mission. "Right now, my mission is to ensure that my kids have the same opportunity to make a life for themselves and achieve their goals like I did. " And that means being the kind of conservative, Christian leader in Washington, D.C. that my dad would be proud of. That alone puts you at odds with the D.C. Establishment, by the way. I'm not interested in the cocktail parties, or rubbing elbows with different special interest groups. The Washington Elite and their allies in the mainstream media can cast judgment all they want. That doesn't bother me. Because at the end of the day, I know that I serve an audience of one -- and that I am doing all that I can with the blessings given to me, and the faith entrusted to me, to glorify God. "So, now that you know just a little bit more about me, where I come from, and what keeps me going, I humbly ask if you are willing to stand alongside me in this fight? " | | I'm not going to lie to you, it won't be easy. But doing what's right rarely is. Thank you for your time and support, | Speaker Mike Johnson * | | | Paid for by Mike Johnson for Louisiana P.O. So many of us will never forget the feeling of disbelief when Trump won in 2016. Our shock didn’t last long before it filled with action, and we descended on Washington and our state capitals in protest and demonstration for change. That energy compelled us to flip the House in 2018, win back the presidency in 2020, and make history here in Michigan in 2022, where I flipped this seat, electing the first Democratic woman in West Michigan history.

And now, the thing I hear most from my supporters is how tired they are, how much they feel “Maxed out on Crisis.” Outrage is very hard to sustain, and I don’t want disengagement to be an option either. So, I have a suggestion for us all – _what if we do this on low power mode?_

**Low. Power. Mode.** I’m not asking anyone to chant or cheer. I’m not asking anyone to knit a pink hat. I’m not asking anyone to feel the same fire they felt in 2018 when faced with the very first opportunity to reject a growing extremism in our country.

Some of the hardest battles in our country have been won through sustained action (even when we didn’t feel like it, even when it took far, far longer than it should have). The main push for women’s suffrage lasted close to a decade, and with each passing election, women held and lost hope that this might be their year. Some, like Inez Mulholland, didn’t even live to enjoy the impacts of her work. So, too, with the push to abolish slavery, establish a democracy, and so on. **It’s clear that extremism is here to stay, and so too must our work to make sure it doesn’t take control. Any of our big battles as a nation – anything worth winning – has been obtained by pushing through even the hardest and most exasperating times.**

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: My slate of the most sweeping set of anti-corruption plans since Watergate.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
All of these plans have two things in common.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=1944%2E4032634%2EA1ik9r)
---
Here's the way I see it: The American people should have complete confidence that government officials are making decisions with only one factor in mind: the public interest. Not their own pocketbooks. Not their future job prospects in the private sector. Not the wishes of big donors and giant corporations. _The public interest._ So I’ve got a whole bunch of plans to root corruption out of Washington. Some are more specific, like my Department of Defense Ethics and Anti-Corruption Act, which would limit the influence of contractors on the military, constrain foreign influence on retired senior military officers, and require greater transparency from contractors in their interactions with the Pentagon. Or my **Judicial Ethics and Anti-Corruption Act** , which would strengthen ethical standards up and down our judiciary, impose an enforceable code of conduct on the Supreme Court, and ban federal judges from owning individual stock. Or my **Presidential Conflicts of Interest Act** , which would require the president and vice president to disclose and divest from any potential financial conflicts of interest. That’s a standard that President Joe Biden and Vice President Kamala Harris have already cleared — and that all their successors should be held to. Especially after we saw Donald Trump run the most corrupt administration in modern history. Or my **bipartisan legislation to reform the Federal Reserve** , which would bar big bank executives from serving on Reserve Bank boards of directors, subject directors to ethics and financial conflict of interest rules, and bring increased transparency and accountability to the Fed. And then I’ve got my big plan: the **Anti-Corruption and Public Integrity Act**. It’s the most sweeping set of reforms since Watergate. And it would fundamentally change the way Washington does business, including...
* Banning all individual stock ownership by members of Congress, Cabinet secretaries, senior congressional staff, federal judges, White House staff, and other senior agency officials while in office.
* Prohibiting all federal officials from holding or trading stock if its value might be influenced by their agency, department, or actions.
* Tightening conflict of interest and recusal requirements.
* Padlocking the revolving door between industry and government.
* Creating a new, independent anti-corruption agency dedicated to enforcing federal ethics laws.
* Expanding an independent and empowered Congressional ethics office.

**All of these plans have two things in common. They’re about putting our government on the side of the people — not the powerful special interests. And they’re only possible if we grow and strengthen our grassroots movement. That’s how we beat Big Money.** [**I’m running for re-election so we can root corruption out of Washington, rebuild our middle class, and strengthen our democracy. But I can’t do it alone. If it makes sense for you right now, will you pitch in $28 or any amount to help build our campaign from the ground up?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/1903?amount=28&t=8&akid=1944%2E4032634%2EA1ik9r)

body:
This is exactly what they wanted.
#
On Friday, the GOP-controlled Alabama Supreme Court ruled that frozen embryos in test tubes are now considered children.
Now, the 1 in 6 families that struggle with infertility, and their doctors, may be open to civil or criminal prosecution in Alabama for using in vitro fertilization to have a baby.1
The GOP is trying to avoid public backlash for the ruling — even Trump has called on Alabama lawmakers to protect families ungergoing IVF treatment. **But this is exactly what they’ve been working towards since attacking Roe v. Wade.**
****
The push to undermine our reproductive rights is coming directly from a patriarchal, theocracy movement in the Republican Party. They’re going after IVF. Contraception. Even ‘recreational sex’. **And they must be stopped.**
[There should never be room for control by force over another person’s body in this country. Will you contribute $3 today so Alexandria can keep pushing for Congress to protect our reproductive freedoms?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240226.CB30d7&refcode=em20240226-5885-P_FND_CTR_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5885%2E2526796%2EVDma9W)

| | _**Each week, Mike Rogers will share the latest under the radar intelligence on the actions of our foes and their efforts to undermine America, highlighting its implications for families in Michigan.**_
---
Did you wake up last week and not have any cell service? It looks like AT&T; rolled out an update to their network, bringing [down](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=04404756ac5a455a9d56684ddd9f8c73&_e=phqHYnGaxM-und94oN0vqXDghszhiDVi1bfg2kloVYWOwbR94YM93ziiT3KVR3L2umZ4A0YXiJONjMLxi0hpjLFDLOLM098zUrtgf0Nz3I75TYDhBMyEFKm24yX4qycsVOpPFDu-HzFq_Wi03T2TDP-1sCF3rUAmsKztz_e81hPIjMjztSYFrVhAlMbBaBKNAvya9r366YrmlsGdoqStoEKE6EYirAM8L4QuUZLlEno13dhG_2eIpER4hgbrialGiPem0RcaKy-UUSZ2HOCrU18y-eliRJo7J35WnvvImWs%3D) their network temporarily. As robust as our networks are, there are still risks and vulnerabilities, and this incident shows just how reliant we are on these modern networks. When I was Chairman of the Intelligence Community, we regularly warned about the risks and threats to our current and future networks, not the least of which came from China. Next generation networks are going to unleash our country’s economic prosperity, but only if we ensure they are both secure and robust.
---
|
---
This week international law enforcement including the United States and United Kingdom, scored one for the good guys, taking down the infrastructure of one of the most prolific ransomware groups in the world, [LockBit](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=04404756ac5a455a9d56684ddd9f8c73&_e=phqHYnGaxM-und94oN0vqR3cMuSmzfpjngKOKyTdBQoXLlFWhqnGhX34pGfPMjXxMkoXLz8hkyCr_qe-NNC6LGbHvnqCapBw3Tnxg0KiIIaeLgkD8EUx_efqRDxkmFFF0HVK1iYa9xkusgZBz4522KCTZRwhhrcicy_3jfZDiqU09dBVWXciRp-QUtaK80lxxnJpSeVG9p9KwFbyBL3Rp11rmq8upMtQ-FdM7axcmQcFtIybvi6XYpHSNIFLyRKAmV18CzIQD455JG1KRwWLSA%3D%3D). Ransomware has been in the news and with good reason—hackers are locking users out of their computers and threatening to release it to the public. Taking down LockBit’s infrastructure is a big victory, but the threat of ransomware isn’t going away. If you don’t use two-factor authentication, you should, and if something doesn’t seem right or sound suspicious in email or a text message, trust your gut and don’t click.

Once again, we find ourselves on the edge of a government shutdown.
#
Derek, there’s no excuse for this.
When people send their representatives to the Capitol, they expect them to do their jobs.
But once again, we find ourselves on the edge of a Republican government shutdown.
It’s a crisis owned entirely by the GOP in the House, by Speaker Mike Johnson and his extremist caucus — a crisis entirely of their own making. At every turn they are incapable of the very basics of governing, the job they were sent to the Capitol to do.
The extremist House Freedom Caucus proposed a funding bill that is unacceptable. Among other extremist positions it would further restrict access to reproductive health care for members of the Military and slash our commitment to fighting climate change — one of the greatest National Security threats our nation faces. Reports are that Mike Johnson is too weak to oppose their fringe agenda.
And if Republicans fail to pass a funding bill, there will be grave consequences. Chief among them a shutdown of the VA, crippling access to the health care and support programs that countless Veterans depend on.
Whatever happens, VoteVets will be pushing to fund the government and deliver on the promises we made to the men and women who served our nation. They have earned that much.
And we will hold every Republican who would restrict those rights, slash those benefits, or endanger our National Security to account.
Of that you have our word.

| | Last week we got devastating news out of Alabama, where the state Supreme Court handed down a ruling effectively putting an end to in vitro fertilization, otherwise known as IVF, indefinitely. Countless Americans rely each year on the IVF process to have a baby, but this ruling will mean that countless couples in Alabama will be left unable to bring a child into their lives. When _Roe_ was overturned, I and many others warned that it was just the tip of the iceberg with how far Republicans nationwide would go to overturn Americans' rights to make health care decisions without government interference. Unfortunately, this latest news out of Alabama is further proof that we were right. This ruling was the direct result of _Roe_ being overturned. But Republicans aren't going to stop at abortion – they're gleefully going after every facet of freedom in our personal lives. They won't rest until there's a politician in every exam room and bedroom in the country. The decision to start a family is a deeply personal one, and one that brings joy to so many mothers and fathers around the country each and every day. Now, extremist Republicans have denied that right to start a family – denied that joy – to countless couples across Alabama. Make no mistake: they won't stop here. Republican lawmakers have made it clear they've set their sights on everything from a national abortion ban, to contraception, the right to marry who you love, and many other deeply personal freedoms. If Republicans are allowed to regain control of the Senate and White House, and maintain control in the House this November, they will go after our fundamental rights. We can be certain of that. Our country is at a crossroads, and our fundamental constitutional rights hang in the balance. clean_body: | | | | Last week we got devastating news out of Alabama, where the state Supreme Court handed down a ruling effectively putting an end to in vitro fertilization, otherwise known as IVF, indefinitely. Countless Americans rely each year on the IVF process to have a baby, but this ruling will mean that countless couples in Alabama will be left unable to bring a child into their lives. When Roe was overturned, I and many others warned that it was just the tip of the iceberg with how far Republicans nationwide would go to overturn Americans' rights to make health care decisions without government interference. Unfortunately, this latest news out of Alabama is further proof that we were right. This ruling was the direct result of Roe being overturned. But Republicans aren't going to stop at abortion – they're gleefully going after every facet of freedom in our personal lives. They won't rest until there's a politician in every exam room and bedroom in the country. The decision to start a family is a deeply personal one, and one that brings joy to so many mothers and fathers around the country each and every day. Now, extremist Republicans have denied that right to start a family – denied that joy – to countless couples across Alabama. Make no mistake: they won't stop here. Republican lawmakers have made it clear they've set their sights on everything from a national abortion ban, to contraception, the right to marry who you love, and many other deeply personal freedoms. If Republicans are allowed to regain control of the Senate and White House, and maintain control in the House this November, they will go after our fundamental rights. We can be certain of that. subject: I'm running to succeed Katie Porter in Congress.

body:
| Friend,

I'm Joanna Weiss. In my life I’ve been a law school professor, community activist, working mother, and I'm proud to share that _I'm running for Congress in California's 47th District._

Our district has been so fortunate to have been represented by Katie Porter in Congress. But with her announcement to run for U.S. Senate, this seat is now vacant and I intend to continue upholding our community's shared progressive values in Washington.

[**The 47th District is the only Democratic seat in California that is both open and listed as a TOSS-UP. We’re aiming to bring in 500 donations today to keep our strong momentum. Please make a contribution to my campaign and the Voter Protection Project to support our effort to keep the 47th District blue.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/62735?t=6&akid=13116%2E878179%2Er3O5Ld) | [**DONATE »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/62735?t=7&akid=13116%2E878179%2Er3O5Ld)
---
I was born and raised in Orange County, and it’s where my husband and I now raise our three children.

After our nation took an unimaginable turn in the 2016 election, I was spurred into action and founded Women for American Values and Ethics (WAVE) -- a woman-led, grassroots organization dedicated to advancing progressive values and ethics.
[ ](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/62735?t=8&akid=13116%2E878179%2Er3O5Ld)
What started as 21 women in my living room grew into a force _several thousand_ strong in Orange County, and organizing efforts played a key role in flipping four Orange County congressional seats from red to blue.

**But friend, things have changed since the Blue Wave of 2018.**

Only _one of the four_ congressional Democrats we elected is left defending their seat.

Following the pandemic, the Orange County community we love and hoped would become a model for change instead saw a spike in extremism, anti-Asian and anti-Semitic racism, and homophobic policies. With Republicans in control of Congress, we've seen horrific attacks on our fundamental rights — including our right to choose.

**If we’re going to protect our progress, we need to re-energize the grassroots who set the Blue Wave in motion. And we need to elect a pro-choice woman to replace Katie Porter in Congress.**

We’ve proven what we can accomplish when thousands of us step up and demand change. That's why I'm running, and I'd be honored to have your support.

[**Help us send a message of widespread, local support. Please split a donation between my campaign and the Voter Protection Project today.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/62735?t=9&akid=13116%2E878179%2Er3O5Ld)

“Trackers” are essentially professional stalkers – the political version of paparazzi. They’re paid by Super PACs or groups funded by the Koch brothers to follow you around with a video camera everywhere you go. Often, they yell ridiculous questions and try to get you to say something that they can then edit up and spin into a fake scandal or put in attack ads.
Well, the first tracker of the campaign began showing up to my events with voters this week – recording every word I say and every breath I take.
This is going to be one of the closest and most important races on Election Night. In 2022, I lost to Lauren Boebert by just 546 votes.

I had never heard the term until after I decided to first run for office against Lauren Boebert in 2022. “Trackers” are essentially professional stalkers – the political version of paparazzi. They’re paid by Super PACs or groups funded by the Koch brothers to follow you around with a video camera everywhere you go. Often, they yell ridiculous questions and try to get you to say something that they can then edit up and spin into a fake scandal or put in attack ads. Well, the first tracker of the campaign began showing up to my events with voters this week – recording every word I say and every breath I take. This is going to be one of the closest and most important races on Election Night. In 2022, I lost to Lauren Boebert by just 546 votes. We can win this critical seat, but the Super PACs are coming after me. They know how close this race is going to be – especially now that Lauren Boebert has run off scared. body:
My family and I moved to the Chicago suburbs in 1988, and this place has been my home ever since.
# [](https://act.qasimforcongress.org/go/8?t=1&akid=35193%2E120265%2EzdXeT4)
Hi, Friend,
I hope this message finds you well. I'm reaching out to you today because I need your support more than ever.
Recently, during a joint media interview, my opponent, Democratic incumbent Bill Foster, made a statement that deeply troubled me. He complained that I am "blathering on about my Illinois roots." [You can watch the video here.](https://act.qasimforcongress.org/go/6242?t=2&akid=35193%2E120265%2EzdXeT4)
This comment not only undermines my personal story but also disrespects the very essence of what it means to be a proud Chicagoan.
[](https://act.qasimforcongress.org/go/6242?t=3&akid=35193%2E120265%2EzdXeT4)
[You can donate to our campaign here.](https://act.qasimforcongress.org/go/6243?t=4&akid=35193%2E120265%2EzdXeT4 "")
Let me share with you a bit about my journey. My family and I moved to the Chicago suburbs in 1988, and this place has been my home ever since. I am proud to have attended school here, including earning my undergraduate degree at the University of Illinois Chicago. This is where I bought my first home, where I married my wife, and where we welcomed our first child into the world.
After attending law school and kicking off my human rights career out of state, I returned to Illinois to care for my father, who suffers from late-stage Parkinson's disease. It's here, in the heart of the Chicago suburbs, that I am raising my children, just as I was raised.
[I invite you to watch this video, where I share my story.](https://act.qasimforcongress.org/go/6242?t=5&akid=35193%2E120265%2EzdXeT4 "")
I am proud of my roots in Illinois. They are not something to be dismissed or trivialized. They are an integral part of who I am and why I am running for Congress—to represent the values and aspirations of the people of Illinois's 11th Congressional District.
But I cannot do this alone. [I need your help to ensure that my voice—and the voices of all Illinoisans—are heard loud and clear in Washington.](https://act.qasimforcongress.org/go/6243?t=6&akid=35193%2E120265%2EzdXeT4 "") Your support is crucial to our success.
[You can donate to our campaign here, even $1 will help.](https://act.qasimforcongress.org/go/6243?t=7&akid=35193%2E120265%2EzdXeT4 "") Will you stand with me?
Thank you for your support.
Sincerely,

I'm reaching out to you today because I need your support more than ever. Recently, during a joint media interview, my opponent, Democratic incumbent Bill Foster, made a statement that deeply troubled me. He complained that I am "blathering on about my Illinois roots." This comment not only undermines my personal story but also disrespects the very essence of what it means to be a proud Chicagoan. "" Let me share with you a bit about my journey. My family and I moved to the Chicago suburbs in 1988, and this place has been my home ever since. I am proud to have attended school here, including earning my undergraduate degree at the University of Illinois Chicago. This is where I bought my first home, where I married my wife, and where we welcomed our first child into the world. After attending law school and kicking off my human rights career out of state, I returned to Illinois to care for my father, who suffers from late-stage Parkinson's disease. It's here, in the heart of the Chicago suburbs, that I am raising my children, just as I was raised. "" I am proud of my roots in Illinois. They are not something to be dismissed or trivialized. They are an integral part of who I am and why I am running for Congress—to represent the values and aspirations of the people of Illinois's 11th Congressional District. But I cannot do this alone. "" Your support is crucial to our success. "" Will you stand with me? Thank you for your support. Sincerely, — Qasim Rashid

body:
A crypto-industry backed super PAC is threatening to decide this election for California.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=38313%2E3422442%2Ekzp1se)
Derek,
A crypto-industry backed super PAC is threatening to decide this election for California.
As Politico just reported, _“California has emerged as its first big target, with Fairshake spending $6.8 million to dislodge progressive Rep. Katie Porter from the Senate race.”_
**This is bigger than just this race:** Our campaign is a chance to prove that people-powered candidates have a shot. Katie is the only candidate in this race who has never taken corporate PAC money and rejects federal lobbyist money. If these special interest groups see that a few million dollars is enough to sway a race, they won’t hesitate to keep dumping money to keep other effective leaders out of office.
---
**We need Katie in Congress to stand up to exactly the people who are trying to take her down:** Billionaires, corporate special interests, and establishment politicians think they have the power to choose California’s next Senator, but we have the power to fight back. We’re in a dead heat for second place (and second place means we advance to the general), but we need to increase our ad spend if we’re going to pull ahead and make the top two.
---
**The reality of these shady groups is this:** super PACs can spend unlimited amounts of money collected from a few billionaires. These shady groups don’t even have to fully disclose who is funding them, and they could drop millions more into this race at any minute. We can’t leave their ads unanswered, but right now our opponents are outspending us on TV 3 to 1.
---

One of the real joys of being a global generalist is that I constantly interact with people from different backgrounds across varied industries and numerous geographies. In the past six months alone, I've spent time meeting, speaking, or advising companies and individuals in Australia, Hong Kong, Canada, The United States, Panama, Colombia, Brazil, and the United Arab Emirates. I've spoken with executives and leaders in finance, agriculture, raw materials, professional services, transportation, construction, energy, and the education sectors. Unsurprisingly, the folks I've met have had a wide range of views on an even wider range of topics. Given the breadth of my exposure to diverse perspectives, it's rare for me to hear thoughts that genuinely shock me.
Yet that's exactly what happened this month when a senior leader whom I've known for years suggested it was problematic for me to have shared Nobel prize winning economist Milton Friedman's _New York Times_ article from 1970 about the social responsibility of business. I had shared it with a small group of leaders as we had been discussing the growing ESG focus in corporate America. My intent was to spur thinking around an important topic and to suggest there were alternative ways to think about the prevailing convention. And frankly, many of Professor Friedman's ideas are as relevant today as they when he wrote them more than fifty years ago.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7e8aee91-203c-4193-83ea-acaccabe9f45?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Source: [https://timesmachine.nytimes.com/timesmachine/1970/09/13/issue.html](https://substack.com/redirect/3d6737a2-6321-4d73-8601-757c388a6c1f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The opening paragraph of the article, "[The Social Responsibility of Business Is To Increase Profits](https://substack.com/redirect/686723b2-b7b3-432a-8774-2b7ffbaa7a0b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)," eloquently lays out the problem that Professor Friedman had with the pursuit of social goals:
> _**[WHEN I hear businessmen speak eloquently about the"social responsibilities of business in a free‐enterprise system," I am reminded of the wonderful line about the Frenchman who discovered at, the age of 70 that he had been speaking prose all his life. The businessmen believe that they are defending free enterprise when they declaim that business is not concerned "merely" with profit but also with promoting desirable "social" ends; that business has a "social conscience" and takes seriously its responsibilities for providing employment, eliminating discrimination, avoiding pollution and whatever else may be the catchwords of the contemporary crop of reformers. In fact they are--or would be if they or any one else took them seriously-- preaching pure and unadulterated socialism.](https://substack.com/redirect/cdd2295d-190f-4bc0-9263-74bfa370ed6f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_
Friedman goes on to note how management is merely executing a plan on behalf of owners, and that actions that take money away from shareholders can be better understood as a tax. He goes on to suggest a few examples:
> _**[What does it mean to say that the corporate executive has a"social responsibility" in his capacity as businessman?... It must mean that he is to act in some way that is not in the interest of his employers. For example, that he is to refrain from increasing the price of the product in order to contribute to the social objective of preventing inflation, even though a price increase would be in the best interests of the corporation. Or that he is to make expenditures on reducing pollution beyond the amount that is in the best interests of the corporation or that is required by law in order to contribute to the social objective of improving the environment. Or that, at the expense of corporate profits, he is to hire "hard core" unemployed instead of better qualified available workmen to contribute to the social objective of reducing poverty. In each of these cases, the corporate executive would be spending someone else's money for a general social interest. Insofar as his actions in accord with his "social responsibility" reduce returns to stock holders, he is spending their money. Insofar as his actions raise the price to customers, he is spending the customers' money. Insofar as his actions lower the wages of some employes, he is spending their money.](https://substack.com/redirect/cdd2295d-190f-4bc0-9263-74bfa370ed6f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/cdd2295d-190f-4bc0-9263-74bfa370ed6f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
A better solution, he notes, is for businesses and their leaders to focus on maximizing shareholder returns over the long term so that shareholders might be free to do what they wish with their profits. Not doing so, Friedman suggests, is an act of management taxing stakeholders without representation.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..O1GpSgUNpmOWX6T1Cz0yDejciYnNbRXeVFkOFi1Rpp4?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=142046531)
It's stunning to see the parallels of Friedman's piece with today's environment. One argument I often hear is that today's challenges are simply too difficult to overcome via market mechanisms alone. The problems are too urgent to wait for political or cultural change, the argument goes, and therefore businesses must play a role in addressing these social challenges by being more "responsible."
Consider what Friedman wrote in 1970: "[the problems are too urgent to wait on the slow course of political processes, that the exercise of social responsibility by businessmen is a quicker and surer way to solve pressing current problems](https://substack.com/redirect/cdd2295d-190f-4bc0-9263-74bfa370ed6f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." He goes on to note that this logic is an admission that society appears unwilling to institute such social change, and social activists are "[seeking to attain by undemocratic procedures what they cannot attain by democratic procedures](https://substack.com/redirect/cdd2295d-190f-4bc0-9263-74bfa370ed6f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." He goes on to admit "[in a free society it is hard for 'good' people to do 'good,' but that is a small price to pay for making it hard for 'evil' people to do 'evil,' especially since one man's good is another's evil](https://substack.com/redirect/cdd2295d-190f-4bc0-9263-74bfa370ed6f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ee039cf0-0abe-4708-96be-6271707e9aed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Source: [https://reason.com/2020/09/14/milton-friedman-accused-of-making-corporations-greedy/](https://substack.com/redirect/8830e134-1407-4dec-aaf2-99fd066f9d6a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Friedman concludes his piece with a quote from his book, _**[Capitalism and Freedom](https://substack.com/redirect/c6bb371a-2a3e-415d-a5ed-4b318db20440?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_ : "[there is one and only one social responsibility of business-- to use its resources and engage in activities designed to increase its profits so long as it stays within the rules of the game, which is to say, engages in open and free competition without deception or fraud](https://substack.com/redirect/cdd2295d-190f-4bc0-9263-74bfa370ed6f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." Professor Friedman's logic is the case for **shareholder capitalism** , a governance structure that focuses on **profit**.
The alternative to a pure profits objective is offered by **stakeholder capitalism**. While shareholder capitalism focuses on generating returns for the owners of a business, a stakeholder focus considers everyone who is impacted by the decisions of a business (employees, the community, the environment, etc.).
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..O1GpSgUNpmOWX6T1Cz0yDejciYnNbRXeVFkOFi1Rpp4?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=142046531)
A clear and succinct articulation of the case for stakeholder capitalism was made by World Economic Forum founder Klaus Schwab in a post called **[The Davos Manifesto 2020](https://substack.com/redirect/44553e58-76cd-4aef-ae4a-3351a1286b91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** ; in it, he stated "[a company serves not only its shareholders, but all its stakeholders - employees, customers, suppliers, local communities and society at large](https://substack.com/redirect/44553e58-76cd-4aef-ae4a-3351a1286b91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." The stakeholder logic is a governance structure that tends to focus on **purpose**.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c10d805a-e5b3-4969-807c-6ee4a4c1902b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Source: [https://www.weforum.org/agenda/2020/07/klaus-schwab-nature-jobs-great-reset-podcast/](https://substack.com/redirect/8d48fe46-adac-480c-b99d-22e4df8e4398?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thus, the debate over the social responsibility of a business seems to be an either-or choice. Either profits or purpose. Either stakeholders or shareholders. I really believe the very framing of shareholder vs. stakeholder is counter-productive. It presents the interest of many stakeholders as being at odds with shareholder return. **[Perhaps the actual problem is one of short-termism?](https://substack.com/redirect/0b37889f-757b-4852-9250-fd9c6222616a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
In the long run, a business that fails to treat its employees well will not have employees, or a business. In the long run, companies that pollute will hurt the very environment in which executives raise their families. And in the long run, every business leader I know wants harmonious relations with their local community, because they live in those communities. It's only in the short-run that some of these matters become tradeoffs. This leads me to conclude that a **long-term orientation is the ultimate best path forward**.
Corporate boards work for the shareholders, but increasingly, they understand that their responsibility is to focus on the long-term. [The Commonsense Principles for Corporate Governance](https://substack.com/redirect/20c6904a-6eeb-4822-83ca-07308a05b10f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), originally published in 2016 and updated in 2018, provides a framework for how they can do so. The Principles stress the importance of having directors who represent long-term shareholders. Specifically, the Principles call for "[Creation of shareholder value, with a focus on the long term. This means encouraging the sort of long-term thinking owners of a private company might bring to their strategic discussions, including investments that may not pay off in the short run](https://substack.com/redirect/20c6904a-6eeb-4822-83ca-07308a05b10f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)."
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..O1GpSgUNpmOWX6T1Cz0yDejciYnNbRXeVFkOFi1Rpp4?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=142046531)
It may also be a matter of semantics. If diversity efforts are intended to identify the best possible professionals to fill a job, is that any different than just good human capital strategy? If a company is responding to a customer's desires for lower carbon emission in its supply chain, isn't that designing an offering that is attractive to customers? Isn't it just "good business" to find the best talent and meet customer needs?
Ultimately, I've come to conclude that the social responsibility of business is to increase its long-term profits and that by articulating the components of a good long-term strategy, there is no false choice between shareholders and stakeholders. Unfortunately, however, the focus of boards is too often on the short-term. It's time to take a step back, dismiss false trade-offs, and restore a focus on maximizing long-term profits with purpose.

Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. [ ](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b7f0736753544c068572cd5d0e45485e&_e=fGHVBNLMjPvpZ1Qb-itH7b7aK4ffhnZ_Gz3ox_O7wzKJLbvCpclokmNGglHK_P54MP4tg_tfS_TDJfKKd7_oGinLEHqBYknHqqx3Iprk9Hkufz5KxPO6d627GLxb4lVaevyr_JGSrNABQ4fuimDwessGSX88p7bS1mzYAM7T2AkHIhKYvq9UvoX8tsYh-6B4CIaFtBc7r64_3RBVBujPqcF3LDV21dszMlmDJ5aPiOZgYYknSBoXcNZAurTh2RgO9BHPj7zmSrWL35F_iEz-DNNIb98K1YHwwZHPI8Wbo0wLm7_qLdh1r2KoZ2kovpH76ZUnrrw32sQfTolHPPwKZFY6YR8FGLPn-RsQOT4JzTHBRohiD5hxhprzijYv0h4fiyshM8AQq60GeH9BYwlHmAGCWmcQ7sZz1AJY7eyrJrw%3D) That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b7f0736753544c068572cd5d0e45485e&_e=fGHVBNLMjPvpZ1Qb-itH7b7aK4ffhnZ_Gz3ox_O7wzKJLbvCpclokmNGglHK_P54MP4tg_tfS_TDJfKKd7_oGinLEHqBYknHqqx3Iprk9Hkufz5KxPO6d627GLxb4lVaevyr_JGSrNABQ4fuimDwessGSX88p7bS1mzYAM7T2AkHIhKYvq9UvoX8tsYh-6B4CIaFtBc7r64_3RBVBujPqcF3LDV21dszMlmDJ5aPiOZgYYknSBoXcNZAurTh2RgO9BHPj7zmSrWL35F_iEz-DFp0oI1qPY8dHow71UoS9MA3zOCsR98KWDvfFKtYwyXAUJ3PGfoRMSCxCqytwhYEifW_S6kw9uijWTmajYV20CeFKlnn4cC66CdbINF_-c_zWmv09FqICve2c2tQXwIZF_4b-isiuIqK8Ai2RI4Us4E%3D)** Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

## Supreme Court Weighs Social Media Rights
The Supreme Court [heard arguments today](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOpSAUQL9GOwxeEbSg2Mbubbul4V0uendRDPCe2b-fzJSTKU9Oc3L-PNaH48jn9tsdZGtIq8PKb1pBgBGgVtV6G4iAhpZsb-QslRrnod2tUQMa38_O6GkIE_WTC14rHCaQAxK0bEGCkgCml6NWqlMwjjPoGaUOLjx1oyR5ril3fxOfdacQ_6c35Q7T0Ua713qVZvjVwNLAct93dz7xpLt8-gaWK0WujKWBpbyuTAcJTK9cv7O4ibe9iJCJRLmIcBe4uxjp3KiILV3i6fAfeVESsoviIM9OZBIZT9cr2U-yzdZfN8fIRZtGye1wHL8664_XPgIAAP__Jwlwcw) over the free speech rights of social media platforms fighting against Texas and Florida laws that limit their ability to moderate content. The two state laws were designed to protect conservative posts from being blocked or restricted by social media platforms. The platforms' lawyers claimed the right as publishers to moderate their own content. A majority of the justices [appeared skeptical](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFy6yAQAL9G6vCcTocQBcVr3Pm1KTUIDvsyyGgQtpO_zzh1yp1tdvbjsly8ZLlf__uNXUtl8aHJkxdUaBTSQn10iRl57NkNBiwQaTv2N6dhnSeaKfBABjDYZNIIPMwatDFh7sUhIAGiGUBPRCdCrS1ONsCUfFqnjoCjtFJPn0Xu7cYpf5cn11MoW5_drbX96MZ_HZ47PPv9zq_jrd5Qm4TMHZ6Px155YxXKozZ1lCA-q42jeJVyqRK9avzlDzXYYQYfwds1JppjXI1JA3nN46g16b66uL8kZzkm0xFcNy_5t6T9-eUnAAD__wmKYlo) that states can regulate social media content without running afoul of the First Amendment. It may be months before the Court makes its ruling.
## Gallup Tracks Growing U.S. Dissatisfaction
Ahead of next week's State of the Union address, Gallup released a "State of the Nation" survey that shows growing national dissatisfaction toward many areas of American life. The poll showed Americans are less satisfied with the nation's military readiness, immigration, gun regulations, and energy policies, which all fell by double digits. body:
Keep President Trump on the ballot

Friend - this is urgent.

_I’ve filed an amicus brief in President Trump’s Supreme Court case_ as Democrats try to **[ELIMINATE](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c695571%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=QYUT2fmn6OEkaILL%2fpJGUQ&sysid=1)** him from the ballot and rob YOU of your right to vote.

But after filing, I realized there’s something more we can do to send a POWERFUL message as the Supreme Court deliberates. . .

_I’m calling on U.S. Voters like YOU all across the country to add your name to my Supreme Court Petition to keep President Trump’s name on the ballot._

******************************************************[ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c695572%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=eyYzWXogOF8MdkfcsHqM1Q&sysid=1)******************************************************

_Let me be as clear as possible ..._

_**[...If Democrats win this Supreme Court case, America will NEVER have a free election again.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c695573%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=bMJz4bJSJX6Zi91jAJ%2bV1w&sysid=1)**_

Tyrants who get a taste of absolute power __NEVER__ abdicate the throne.

You see, if Democrats win this case, they will believe that they no longer have to compete for your vote.

Instead, they’ll turn to the courts to **[STRIKE](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c695574%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=cr6Og%2f5WX0fUHtwoPBnRew&sysid=1)** their opponents from the ballot, and our once Free Republic will have forever fallen to the dark forces of tyranny.

I have to know I did all I could to stand strong against that doomsday scenario.

That’s why I’ve decided to circulate this National Petition to show that voters all across America want President Trump to REMAIN on the ballot in 2024.

I hope I can add your name next, Friend.

**[So please, sign my Supreme Court Petition immediately- as deliberation has already begun.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c695585%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=c8tt1FmCbKmhcJMZrI%2bc8g&sysid=1)**

In Liberty,

Ted Cruz

name: Patti Reilly
subject: The anti-police mob is putting my son in jail
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsCgfEJipN

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osCgfEJipN

Dear Friend,

I know you and I have never met. But I'm praying that
you'll help me save my son, Officer Terence Sutton.

This is a picture of Terence and me at a dinner
celebrating his graduation from the Police Academy.

I was so proud that night. But I was also terrified.

Terence was going to be patrolling the streets of
Washington, DC, where crime is sky-high and politicians side with
criminals over cops. But never in my wildest imagination could I
have predicted that my son would be wrongfully convicted of
murder - murder of a criminal my son didn't even touch.

The story is so shocking that if it didn't happen to my
son, I wouldn't even believe it. And I'm praying you will help me
save my son - but first, let me explain what happened.

Our nightmare started in October of 2020.

Terence was sitting in his patrol car when he received a
report that a known gang member, Karon Hylton-Brown, was seen
entering a rival gang's territory.

Karon was a violent criminal with a rap sheet a mile long
- including drugs, illegal gun possession, and assaults. Earlier
that day, he had been seen arguing with a rival gang member who
owed him money. Terence and other officers were concerned Karon
was planning to get revenge.

So when Terence saw him illegally driving a motorized
scooter on the sidewalk without a helmet, he tried to pull Karon
over to talk. Instead, Karon took off on the scooter.

Terence watched as Karon sped through traffic, weaving in
and out of cars and blowing past red lights and stop signs.

My son knew Karon was putting others at risk, so for 3
minutes he slowly and carefully followed behind in his patrol
car.

And then it happened.

Karon veered into an alleyway, drove out the other side
without looking and slammed into a passing car.

After several days in the hospital, Karon died from his
injuries. And here's where the story takes a shocking turn...

Because Karon was black, and the incident happened just
four months after George Floyd's death, the anti-police mob went
into frenzy.

They blamed Terence for the accident and smeared him as a
racist.

There were protests and even riots. The mob threw rocks
at officers, smashed store windows, and set fires.

Anti-police politicians piled on too. Without any
evidence, they demanded my son be charged even though he did
nothing to cause Karon's death.

The pressure campaign worked, and prosecutors charged my
son with Second-Degree Murder.

When Terence called to tell me about the charges, I was
in disbelief. Any sane person could see that Karon's death, while
tragic, was no one's fault but his own.

He chose to run from the cops.

He chose to not wear a helmet.

He chose to speed through that alley without looking
where he was going.

So, when I learned that Terence could be sentenced to
sixty years in prison for Karon's death, my head started
spinning. And it only got worse when the trial began.

You see, the judge refused to allow Terence's legal team
to present all of the facts in his defense.

The jury never got to hear that Karon was a known member
of a violent gang...

They never got to hear that he was wearing an ankle
monitor because of a violent assault he had committed just weeks
before...

They never got to hear that he had drugs and thousands of
dollars in cash strapped to his leg...

And they never got to hear about the drugs in Karon's
system at the time of the crash.

Sitting in the courtroom, I couldn't believe my ears when
the jury filed out and declared Terence "guilty."

He's currently awaiting sentencing.

Now you understand why I'm so heartbroken. The injustice
is almost too much to bear.

My son was well-respected by the community he served. He
trained many Rookies and set a good example for all of them.

He was even awarded Officer of the Year!

And at the same time the bleeding-heart DC politicians
are letting shoplifters, carjackers, and drug dealers walk away
scot-free...

...they're trying to put my son - a decorated officer who
has received 60 awards and commendations - away for 60 years for
something he didn't do.

I had almost lost hope, but then we learned about the Law
Enforcement Legal Defense Fund -or LELDF for short.

If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know they're a
national group fighting on behalf of wrongly-accused police
officers like Terence. LELDF has helped dozens of innocent cops -
and their families - at their lowest moments. And when I got the
call from their president, Jason Johnson, I was at my lowest
moment.

Not only did LELDF decide to help my son get the legal
defense he deserves. They're also raising money to pay for the
best attorneys and expert witnesses for Terence.

So I have to ask you one of the toughest questions I've
ever asked anyone:

Will you help my son Terence fight the unjust charges
against him by donating to LELDF?

To fund his defense, Terence had to sell his home, his
car, his beloved motorcycle, and most of his personal belongings.
Everything he owns now fits in just nine small boxes. He has
almost nothing left.

If I had anywhere else to turn, I wouldn't be so bold as
to ask for your help.

But I already lost my husband. He was a police officer
too, and he was so proud that Terence followed in his footsteps.
And it makes me cry when I think of how he would feel about what
Terence is being put through right now.

I simply can't bear the thought of having another family
member ripped away from me.

So if you are at all able, would you consider following
this link to make a tax-deductible donation to the Law
Enforcement Legal Defense Fund to help my Terence?

Any amount - $35, $50, $100, or even $500 or more - will
help.

And because LELDF is a non-profit organization, your gift
is completely tax-deductible. But whatever you can afford to
give, I ask that you rush it back quickly.

Terence's team is currently looking at every available
option to keep his case alive.

And you and your $35 contribution could make the
difference in Terence being acquitted or spending the next 60
years behind bars.

Right now, Terence can only rely on the good nature and
generosity of kind neighbors like you.

Thank you for taking the time to read my letter today.

And thank you - in advance - for doing what you can to
help all the wrongly-accused officers LELDF is working with. Like
Terence.

Sincerely,

Patti Reilly

P.S. I know a few kind words from someone like you will
help lift Terence's spirits. This guilty verdict has been so
devastating for him. So if you choose to make a $35 gift to
LELDF, would you also please include a little note -maybe a
prayer? There's a field on the page for you to do this. Thank you
-from the bottom of my heart.
--------

More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face
similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men
and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your
community, please thank them for their service. To read more
about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we're
defending, please visit www.PoliceDefense.org. And remember -Blue
Lives Matter!

subject: A critical legislative update!
body:
Despite ongoing liberal resistance, there was a newsworthy breakthrough last week! Democrats reluctantly scheduled hearings for TODAY and TOMORROW to discuss three crucial initiatives: I-2111 (banning all future income taxes), I-2113 (allowing police pursuits), and I-2081 (ensuring parental rights in K-12 education). | | [](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62866982:sUW7oJiNQ:m:1:2610672541:D7FC1B9DF440ABAE509560565CD2F975:r "Shift Washington")

| Friends,

Because of leap year, we have one additional day to reach our monthly fundraising target! But we urgently need your support right now!

We hope that you have found Shift WA a dependable source for updates on the "Let's Go Washington" initiatives during the current legislative session. We've consistently shone a light on Democrat lawmakers who have failed to fulfill their constitutional duty by neglecting to hold public hearings for all six citizen initiatives certified for action.

Despite ongoing liberal resistance, there was a newsworthy breakthrough last week! Democrats reluctantly scheduled hearings for TODAY and TOMORROW to discuss three crucial initiatives: I-2111 (banning all future income taxes), I-2113 (allowing police pursuits), and I-2081 (ensuring parental rights in K-12 education).

Public pressure forced Democrats to schedule these hearings. We consider that a win, knowing that we played a role in keeping the public informed about what's really happening in Olympia.

[**Your support is critical to enabling us to continue our work of holding those in power accountable and keeping you informed.**](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62866983:sUW7oJiNQ:m:1:2610672541:D7FC1B9DF440ABAE509560565CD2F975:r)

2024 National Convention Updates

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/e1f6b6e9ef67/n41kepo7ku-12683217?e=25844e23a8)
https://ne.gop/?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=e5b22027de-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-e5b22027de-21732365

** Good Morning Republicans,
------------------------------------------------------------

The beginning part of every year is filled with so much activity. By the time you roll into March, holidays and sports, cleaning and taxes (let's not go there...) just make every week seem filled to the brim! Right now, the 4 weekends of High School sports are active with Wrestling Finals two weeks ago, Swimming and Diving last weekend and subsequent Girls Basketball Districts and subsequent Boys Basketball Sub-Districts. This weekend Girls Basketball Finals will happen in Lincoln and subsequent Boys Districts. Then the following week Boys Basketball Finals happen in Lincoln! Phew!
Easter is on Sunday, March 31st, with Palm Sunday the week before.
St. Patrick's Day (March 17th) is on a Sunday this year (could make for some rough "Case of the Monday's" back to work for folks!)
Nebraska's Statehood is on Saturday, March 1st along with Senator Deb Fischer's (Happy Birthday Senator Fischer🎂)
March 1st is ALSO the filing deadline for becoming a county delegate (https://sos.nebraska.gov/sites/sos.nebraska.gov/files/doc/elections/2024/County%20Convention%20Delegate%20Form%202024.pdf?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=e5b22027de-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-e5b22027de-21732365) . See the form below and connect with your county party so your voice can make a difference.
https://sos.nebraska.gov/sites/sos.nebraska.gov/files/doc/elections/2024/County%20Convention%20Delegate%20Form%202024.pdf?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=e5b22027de-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-e5b22027de-21732365
In addition to the County Conventions, each County will be sending representatives (State Delegates) to the State Convention on May 18th, 2024 in Lincoln. We have an awesome Featured Speaker - Lt. General Michael Flynn! We will be showing his movie "Flynn - Deliver the Truth. Whatever the Cost."
https://www.flynnmovie.com/?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=e5b22027de-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-e5b22027de-21732365
Our State Constitution has set a cap of State Delegates at 400 (some states go into the 1000's of delegates). Each county gets a minimum of one (1) State Delegate and the same number of State Delegate Alternate(s) in case a State Delegate is unable to attend. The State Delegate allocation for each county is based upon the volume of votes recorded in each county during the previous Presidential Election. In essence, how many votes were cast from each county for President Trump in 2020.
SEE BELOW FOR STATE DELEGATE ALLOCATION BY COUNTY (#State Delegate Allocation)

If you are interested in experiencing the unique 2024 National Convention where the RNC will nominate the NEXT President of the United States you must be a Nebraska National Delegate.
You might be asking...What is the National Convention (https://gopconvention2024.com/?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=e5b22027de-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-e5b22027de-21732365) ? Go to https://gopconvention2024.com/about/?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=e5b22027de-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-e5b22027de-21732365 (https://gopconvention2024.com/?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=e5b22027de-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-e5b22027de-21732365) for more details.
https://youtu.be/ciqyZRizqdA?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=e5b22027de-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-e5b22027de-21732365

During what may be the most important election of our lives, it is the job of the RNC’s Committee on Arrangements (COA) to plan a blockbuster, 4-day Convention that will be broadcast across the world. We will host upwards of 50,000 guests in Milwaukee, including the delegates who will nominate the next President and Vice President of the United States.

Thousands of delegates and alternates will be selected by all 56 states and territories. They will travel to Milwaukee, WI July 15-18, 2024, to meet and select the Republican Nominee for President.
Nebraska is allocated 33 National Delegates and 33 Alternates. At our Nebraska State Convention on Saturday, May 18th in Lincoln, we will elect 3 Delegates (and alternates) from each Congressional District (9) AND then 24 At-Large Delegates (and alternates) equaling 33 Delegates and 33 Alternates.
Based on the State Convention Plan submitted to the RNC (Called the 16-F Plan), if you are interested in being a Nebraska Delegate to the National Convention you MUST be a State Delegate or Alternate. To be a State Delegate or Alternate, you MUST be ELECTED at your County Convention...thus you MUST register to be a County Delegate by March 1st! In the case of certain counties there are very few State Delegates allocated, so connect to your county party and let's represent the Cornhusker Nation proudly in Milwaukee on July 18th!
For more details on opportunities to be apart of the National Convention experience email to information@ne.gop (mailto:information@ne.gop?subject=2024%20National%20Convention%20Inquiry) We also have AMAZING Sponsorship opportunities to showcase your business and brands both at our State Convention and National Convention events. These sponsorships will highlight your company in front of 1000's of Nebraskans and can help gain access to exclusive networking in Milwaukee with key leaders from across the country!
Next week, I will bring more attention to the county parties and the efforts being made to build on the Relational Organization I discussed last week. We have plenty of work to do with Legislation Support, support of candidates, connecting to coalition partners, event planning, and discussing the different committee's and groups need to be successful in 2024!

name: Shamaine Daniels
subject: Scott Perry says NO to IVF
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/99379/images/Daniels%20logo%20header.png]
Dear Friend,
Yesterday, I emailed you with some exciting news. Despite numerous court challenges, last week, the City of Harrisburg won our eight year legal battle over our buffer zone law. I'm proud that me and my colleagues on council stood strong to protect access to reproductive care (in case you missed it, you can read more about the buffer zone decision in my forwarded email below.)
Today, I'm writing to remind you why it is so important that we elect proven advocates for women's reproductive rights in a post- Dobbs America. Just as I am a longtime advocate for women's rights, my opponent has a long history opposing reproductive freedom.
The recent news out of Alabama–that embryos produced for IVF are no longer protected–is terrifying. Scott Perry recently sponsored a bill in Congress restricting access to IVF treatments nationwide [https://dccc.org/scott-perry-co-sponsored-legislation-imposing-restrictions-on-ivf/] . Millions of Americans use IVF as a way to start their families. The government has no business telling these families that they don’t matter and don’t deserve to become parents.
I have spent my career fighting for women’s rights–including their right to make their own healthcare decisions. Every woman in this country has a right to decide if and when they want to start a family. I’m running for Congress to continue this work.
Because of my long history of fighting to protect women’s rights, the National Organization for Women has endorsed my candidacy.
Democrats are only 4 seats away from a majority in the House and our district is a top target. With your help, we can replace Scott Perry and pass legislation that protects a woman's right to choose and make sure all families in our country are recognized and respected.
Join our fight with a contribution of $100, $50, or whatever you can give here. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
With gratitude for your continued support,
- Shamaine
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Begin forwarded message
Sent: Monday, February 26, 2024
From: Shamaine Daniels
Subject: BREAKING - A Victory for Reproductive Rights
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Dear Friend,
Today, I am writing to share some good news. The City of Harrisburg recently scored a victory for women's reproductive rights, when the buffer zone that Harrisburg City Council established around the city's Planned Parenthood clinic to protect patients and staff from harassment, obstruction, and potential violence was upheld after an eight year legal battle.
As a member of City Council in my third term, I am proud to be a part of this victory for women's rights. We deserve elected leaders who we know will walk the walk, because when those who represent us stand up and fight, we can win!
Can you pitch-in $25, $50, $100, $250 or more to support my campaign so I can continue to fight for our values in Congress? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Harrisburg is one of only two cities in Pennsylvania to have a buffer zone, and defending our buffer zone in court has been a long process. Harrisburg City Council established the buffer zone in 2012, and we have spent years defending the ordinance. There have been at least three challenges to it. We could have easily quit fighting and given in, but we didn't. We stood up for what we believe in, and we stood up for the many women who depend on Harrisburg's Planned Parenthood clinic for health and reproductive care.
If you believe we need elected leader who will stand-up and fight, even when it's hard, then I need you to support our campaign with a contribution today. Click here to donate now. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
We need leaders who will stand-up and fight, because when we elect those leaders we can win! Last Tuesday eight years of challenges to our buffer zone law came to an end when SCOTUS declined to hear the case (Reilly, Colleen, et al. v. Harrisburg, PA et al). That means the lower court's opinion upholding the constitutionality of our buffer zone stands.
These days, it can be hard to decide which candidates to support. By donating to my campaign today, you are supporting a candidate that you know will fight for us and stand-up for our priorities because that is what I've spent my career doing. Our end of month fundraising deadline is in a few days, and you contribution to our campaign would make a huge difference.
Click here to support a candidate whom you know will fight for the things that matter most! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
With Gratitude,
Shamaine
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/99379/images/PaidForByDanielsForCongressB.jpg]
Daniels For Congress
2018 N. 3rd Street
Harrisburg, PA 17102

name: Adam Schiff
subject: It wasn’t an easy decision
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=5695%2E5257348%2E3QBCnl ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Derek,

Can I have a moment of your day to explain why I decided to join this U.S.
Senate race?

Over a year ago, I launched our campaign for California’s Senate seat. It
wasn’t an easy decision. I’ve proudly served Californians in Congress —
fighting to pass legislation that really moves us forward and defends our
democracy.

And after long nights of weighing it and talking with Eve, I ultimately
decided to step up for one reason: The most important fights for our
democracy in the next several years will be fought in the U.S. Senate.

Abolishing the filibuster.

Filling Supreme Court vacancies.

Protecting our freedoms.

These fights — and so many others — will be taking place on the floor of
the Senate. It’s important that California has a Senator who believes that
right matters. That truth matters. And that our democracy matters. And who
knows how to take on MAGA extremists to defend our democracy.

They deserve a Senator who will live up to their expectations, make
impactful change, and not be afraid to garner every single resource they
need to flourish.

I’ve been on the frontline of the fight for the heart and soul of our
democracy. And always will be. Our work isn’t over — so I’m committed to
taking our fight straight to the Senate and Trump’s enablers there.

I’ve relied on this grassroots team since I launched my campaign. Your
donations, even just $5 or $10 at a time, helped power our work to hold
Donald Trump and every single one of his far-right enablers accountable.
And it’s only going to get more serious from here.

We’re approaching our end-of-month deadline, and we must report the
strongest numbers to the FEC soon after, especially since Election Day is
in arms reach. I hope I can count on your grassroots support before that
important deadline.

Team -
The NRA has become a shell of the organization it once was. That’s not because of luck.
We have fought tirelessly since our founding to hold the NRA accountable for their blatant disregard for public safety. And now, all of their lies and corruption has caught up to them.

| | | | | Peter, When I retired from the military, I immediately knew what I wanted to do next. During my 40 years of service I had the opportunity to travel the world and experience so much. In the end, the greatest gift was being able to retire back home to Georgia and become a farmer again. [](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tbc46baf7-db7b-4771-b8f0-38634ea6a89d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) My father passed away when I was young but he was a farmer. After he passed, the community stepped up to work our family farm. They took my siblings and I under their wing until we were old enough to handle it ourselves. Those experiences ingrained in me the values of hard work, dedication, community, and love of the land. [](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb32b911a-a372-4bad-9787-813d5b31f280/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Farming here in North Georgia means dealing with a pretty wide range of demands. Recently, I got a herd of cattle and I’m diving into the work of caring for them from managing their grazing areas to ensuring their well-being. [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1958a7b2-2233-48ef-b306-2c326b048beb/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Growing up on a farm cultivates a strong work ethic, and I’m eager to bring those values to Washington. It is my belief that our nation needs representatives who understand the essence of hard work and commitment. Unfortunately, **a strong work ethic is not something we’re getting from Marjorie Taylor Green** , who currently holds this Congressional seat. [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T06117265-2d74-445e-bcd3-8573263bbad5/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) If you agree that we could use more hard work from Congress, I could use your help. MTG, whatever her work ethic, has a lot of powerful and wealthy friends. What I have is a nationwide team of regular people. I know we can conquer this incumbent, but the proof is in the pudding. Together, we can champion those values of hard work, dedication, and community. Your contribution will help us amplify our message and meet voters to make a meaningful difference.

I’m going to keep it real with you, fellow activist.

This is the time of year that nonprofits in our space experience delayed funding which forces costly budget restrictions – and we’re in that.

In order to not only retain our current level of operations in quarter one but also ramp up for the critical general election in November, we are depending on grassroots support.

[**By donating $25 or more today, you will directly help us fund essential programs and events to help strengthen our democracy, including candidate forums and community conversations and our year-round work to expand Pennsylvania’s electorate. Will you support us with a donation today?**](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=36868b98c5&e=95417d7e87)

**Here’s the thing:_Pennsylvania is a key battleground state._**

That’s why we are already seeing blatant attempts to make it harder to register to vote and cast a ballot.

According to _CBS News_ , a lawsuit was recently filed by 24 PA Republican state lawmakers, “challenging the legality of a 2021 executive order by Biden that orders federal agencies to consider ways to expand access to registering to vote and information about voting.”

As the CBS News article confirms, **“The lawsuit is expected to be _one of many_ to litigate voting and election rules in a battleground state that is critical to 2024's presidential contest.”**

We know it’s going to happen, and **we have to be able to ramp up NOW in order to defend voting rights in Pennsylvania.**

[**We cannot afford to wait until the Fall to fund our voter engagement and mobilization programs. We need to raise funds NOW to defend against all attacks on voting rights in PA. The primary election is only 57 days away, and we need your support. Please rush $25 or more to help us continue to ramp up in this critical election year.**](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=5df1ee1f8c&e=95417d7e87) _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [**$25 »**](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=6a1b3059cb&e=95417d7e87)

# Army Combat Veteran Running for Congress in Nevada
---
LAS VEGAS (April 10, 2024)--Retired Army Colonel Mark Robertson is running for U.S. Congress in Nevada's First Congressional District. Robertson enlisted in the Army as a Private, then rose through the ranks to eventually retire as a Colonel. He was deployed to ten foreign countries, including Afghanistan, Iraq, Kuwait, and Syria combat zones.
Nevada's First Congressional District includes Boulder City, most of Henderson, and the parts of Las Vegas and Clark County east of Interstate 15. Robertson raised his family in this district and has strong ties to the community.
Robertson joined the Army at age 17, just after graduating high school. He completed basic training at Fort Jackson, SC. Many years later, Robertson returned to Ft. Jackson and commanded the same company to which he was assigned as a Private. His son would later join the Army and was assigned to the same training battalion.
Robertson and his son, Sergeant Steve Robertson, deployed to Iraq at the same time in 2010-2011. Robertson says, "It was an honor to serve with my son, but it was terrifying for my wife. She flew a flag with two blue stars outside our house for the year we were deployed." In recognition of his service in Iraq, Robertson received the Bronze Star.
Having served in the enlisted and officer ranks, Robertson is uniquely qualified to represent the Veterans in his district. He comes from a military family where both his parents served in the Navy. His dad was a Corpsman attached to the Marine Corps. Robertson understands the issues facing veterans. "I have a lot of respect and love for the men and women who sacrificed to serve our Nation," Robertson says.
When asked why he is running for Congress, Robertson said, "This is not something I ever thought I would do, but I don't like the direction of our country and want to help things get better." In addition to his 30 years of military service, Robertson owned a small business in Henderson. He has a degree in finance from BYU and an MBA. He taught finance at UNLV. "I know how the economy works and how to balance a budget," he said.
Robertson has experience in Washington, D.C. He served in the Pentagon, was on the faculty of the National Defense University, and was a delegate to the Global Coalition Against ISIS. His military awards include the Legion of Merit, Defense Meritorious Service Medal, Airborne Badge, and Good Conduct Medal.
People can learn more about Robertson at his campaign website, [www.RobertsonForCongress.com](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001fRdxuhv60XpuFQLoiiVUr7x9-EN1AqYTKetowSOXBjYWZUZIWiYe_RAIrUxk07Ag6JpVjN9TV86jkiK9Uzi6zz_AhT1HFXZ39LxT371SC3T8ZnNkNlFrekDf0BeOzHDHbVq4WcUuwUbk5wobSiEsRKK8XbRNj5bh&c=q60ieb5suHKUs6q_KFWIQWEnxD7Q06CThGKkqDhW8GGiQAErdN76nA==&ch=T4V4PgxivQb4PSlyNOUvcHBG0_1txKuULsjYrct1-Aug0hqEdQxE1A==)

Fellow Conservative,

Some say that our district should be safe for Republicans in November, but with almost half the district as “new territory,” we are not taking any chances. **The way people lose is to forget who they are, where they come from and who they represent.** I’ve seen former colleagues make this mistake before; I made a vow to myself to never become complacent.

So, here we are once again, **eight months until Election Day!**

They don't like debating with me with regard to important legislation in the House, and **they cannot stand how we're helping the American public come to the realization that Democrats are more focused on partisanship than getting things done for the American people**.

So, if you agree with me that:
