**Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom Earns Endorsement from Majority Whip Tom Emmer in her Race for U.S. Congress** _House Republican Leadership Team Backs Dahlstrom_
**Anchorage, AK** \- Today, Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom earned the endorsement of Majority Whip Tom Emmer in her race for Congress. Emmer joins Speaker Mike Johnson, Leader Steve Scalise, and Chairwoman Elise Stefanik in backing Dahlstrom, giving her the support of the House Republican Leadership team. Alaska Governor Mike Dunleavy has also announced his support of the Lt. Governor’s bid, consolidating the major Republican support behind her candidacy.
**"Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom is the right choice for Alaska and best positioned to win this seat. Nancy never backs down from a tough fight, and I know she will continue to put Alaskans first when she gets to Washington. I'm excited to work with her to flip this seat and grow our Republican majority,”** stated Majority Whip Tom Emmer.
Whip Emmer represents Minnesota’s 6th Congressional District in Congress. Before becoming Majority Whip in the 118th Congress, he served as Chairman of the National Republican Congressional Committee.
**“I am so appreciative of Whip Emmer’s support and along with the backing of the rest of House Republican Leadership. They see that we need to flip this seat in November to ensure we have a strong Republican Majority that can focus on a true conservative agenda that works for Alaska,”** stated Lt. Governor Dahlstrom.
Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom announced her race at the end of last year and has already consolidated support from key local and national Republicans, after raising $200k in just one month. She entered the race [citing](https://nancyforalaska.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b2d5cc6ac5f5c7539b4b1d46&id=2c32171688&e=a20d8ad2ed) failed leadership from current incumbent Mary Peltola and will face-off against her first in the open primary on August 20th.
_Nancy Dahlstrom currently serves as the Lt. Governor for the state of Alaska. Nancy was first appointed to serve as a State Representative in 2003 and then served as a Senior Advisor for Military Affairs. In 2018, Nancy took on the role to serve as the Commissioner of Corrections and was a leader in cracking down on crime and ensuring criminals serve their time. As Lieutenant Governor, Nancy has prioritized public safety, energy security, and emergency preparedness._

subject: This is how we’ll keep PA blue in 2024

body:
Bear with me while I get a little sentimental, okay?
#
Derek,
A few days ago, we had a big community event in ruby-red Mercer County. Bear with me while I get a little sentimental, okay? 😭
Back in 2021, we said that our movement would flip PA blue because our motto was **Every County, Every Vote.** We put in thousands of miles criss-crossing the Commonwealth on a journey that we knew wouldn’t be easy, but would be *BIG*. _And we won._
Now we’re still working hard to turn out Democrats and meet supporters all over -- like at our “Big Hug WingFest Thank You Event” (at least that’s what I’ve been calling it 😂).
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240227-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240227-8809&refcode2=8809_434096_VY-PjS&akid=8809%2E434096%2EVY-PjS)
There are a *lot* of cynics who’d tell me that visiting Democrats in places like Mercer County is a waste of time. **Well they’re wrong.** No county is too small, rural, or “too Red” for us to count out. Every Pennsylvanian’s vote matters. That’s how we ran our campaign in 2022, and it’s how we’ll keep PA blue 🔵 in 2024.
**[So here’s the deal. Every single grassroots donation helps power our work, from the biggest cities to the smallest towns in PA. That’s why I’m asking you today: Can you chip in your very first donation before our end-of-month deadline on Thursday?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240227-1?refcode=em20240227-1-8809&refcode2=8809_434096_VY-PjS&akid=8809%2E434096%2EVY-PjS)**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240227-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240227-8809&refcode2=8809_434096_VY-PjS&akid=8809%2E434096%2EVY-PjS)**
I’m sooooo grateful for everything you do, Derek. Let’s keep up the good work together.
John ❤️
John Fetterman
U.S. Senator from Pennsylvania

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20240227-8809-footer&t=1&refcode2=8809_434096_VY-PjS&akid=8809%2E434096%2EVY-PjS)**

| Dear Friends and Neighbors,

It’s championship wrestling season in Pennsylvania. There’s no tougher sport than wrestling, and there’s no better wrestling in the country than our own District 11.

I wrestled for Northwestern Lehigh’s Centennial League championship team in 1986. My three sons each started for the Tigers Varsity lineup in 2019. And for nine years prior, I coached the Northwestern Youth Wrestling Association. Five of the wrestlers advancing to this year’s PIAA AA Southeast Regional Tournament learned the sport in my practice room.

I offer my military and business experience as qualifications for Congress, and that’s important. But we also need Representatives with a proven track record of investing in kids and building strong families. After all, the American family is the foundation of our society, and in many ways, it’s under attack.

By now you probably know I’m married to Susan, my wife of 24 years. Together, we’ve raised three sons- two in college and one a youth pastor serving overseas with the Army National Guard. But my investment in children and families isn’t limited to my own.
* I coached 20 seasons of youth sports, including wrestling, soccer, and baseball. I used to spend 30 hours a week running the wrestling program. Kids around New Tripoli still call me coach.

* I mentor student interns in cybersecurity and entrepreneurship. I’ve met with 21 high school seniors every Wednesday for five years, investing about 1,000 hours. The Bergen County Technical School District named me [Business Partner of the Year](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=6bf0998c14&e=1090c5c412) for my work with their students.

* I counsel young people as a Christian minister. I serve as a substitute pastor for local churches and lead Bible studies. This year, I’ll be conducting marriage counseling for couples and officiating two weddings.

* I help young soldiers and airmen cope with the stress of military life. My wife and I wrote a book on the subject, [Twenty Percent Soldiers](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=2b6056a05d&e=1090c5c412), and we recently met with 800 military members and their families to coach them on resiliency and persistence.

I miss wrestling. I loved rolling around on the mat, teaching the moves, and watching my sons and their friends compete. But I’m doing a different type of wrestling these days. I’m wrestling with a culture gone awry and a political environment filled with anxiety and fear.

But don't lose hope. We’re not going to change our culture with an Act of Congress. That requires patience, commitment, and prayer. But you can send people to Washington who are trained and equipped to fight for our hometown values and the American family. You can send me.

**Keep America Free.**

_Kevin Dellicker is a Republican from Heidelberg Township, Lehigh County, running for U.S. House of Representatives in Pa.’s 7th District. He is a 28-year military veteran, technology company owner, husband and father. He’s not a career politician. He’s a proven leader with the experience and courage to Keep America Free. Learn more at[www.dellickerforcongress.com](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=bb95d7904f&e=1090c5c412)._

I mentor student interns in cybersecurity and entrepreneurship. I’ve met with 21 high school seniors every Wednesday for five years, investing about 1,000 hours. The Bergen County Technical School District named me for my work with their students. I counsel young people as a Christian minister. I serve as a substitute pastor for local churches and lead Bible studies. This year, I’ll be conducting marriage counseling for couples and officiating two weddings. I help young soldiers and airmen cope with the stress of military life. My wife and I wrote a book on the subject, , and we recently met with 800 military members and their families to coach them on resiliency and persistence. I miss wrestling. I loved rolling around on the mat, teaching the moves, and watching my sons and their friends compete. But I’m doing a different type of wrestling these days. I’m wrestling with a culture gone awry and a political environment filled with anxiety and fear. But don't lose hope. We’re not going to change our culture with an Act of Congress. That requires patience, commitment, and prayer. But you can send people to Washington who are trained and equipped to fight for our hometown values and the American family. You can send me. Keep America Free. Kevin Dellicker is a Republican from Heidelberg Township, Lehigh County, running for U.S. House of Representatives in Pa.’s 7th District. He is a 28-year military veteran, technology company owner, husband and father. He’s not a career politician. He’s a proven leader with the experience and courage to Keep America Free. Learn more at. | | Friend, It’s Precinct Caucus Day! Across Minnesota, our best and most loyal Republicans are getting ready to show up and chart our Party’s course for this high-stakes election year. **Please make plans to attend your Caucus tonight at 7:00 PM.** You are EXACTLY the kind of patriot we need guiding our Republican Party at this crucial time. And please also offer me your support. It’s been an honor to serve you for the past two years. Since I arrived in Congress, we flipped the House and FIRED PELOSI, but that was just the beginning of our fight to save America from socialism. As you know, Joe Biden is a disaster at home and abroad. I have firmly endorsed President Trump and am excited to see our Party rallying around him. Polls show we are well-positioned to defeat Biden, and even Minnesota is up for grabs in the presidential race. On top of that, Democrat control of the U.S. Senate is hanging by a thread. But my friend, none of this will matter if we don’t hold on to the House of Representatives! We must give President Trump the partners he needs on Capitol Hill to implement his agenda, especially on BORDER SECURITY. _If they have the power, Democrats will just harass, investigate, obstruct, and impeach him again and again!_ And they will bury us deeper in debt while keeping our borders wide open. Republicans must hold our narrow House Majority. That’s what makes our work here in southern Minnesota so critical. I am anxious to work shoulder to shoulder with you to win this November and secure the bright future we all want to leave for the next generation. **But that work** _**really**_**begins tonight, and your voice is important!**** ** So please attend your Precinct Caucus. Please offer me your support – I will deeply appreciate the honor. And then please stand with me in the high-stakes fight against Biden’s socialists between now and November. Thank you and God bless! Brad Finstad P.S. If you don’t know where your caucus is being held, you can look it up at the [**_Secretary of Sta_**** _te’s website_**](http://links.thelukenscompany.mkt6815.com/els/v2/j_69tPZ_ZwTZ/Mk5Da0kzVjFnRmUzeTlIejZPT24xZGlRWlZBd1RobjRhYTk2OHBYeGxyN3AzS2o1SWZkR1g5Yi9vWHp6bXQyenhwZi9pcWFhRGYyd0dNT0xNUHIzRUtlb04wZHVXdnp3U1dGTW1Zb2tiVktaUElmQlV2MU1nZz09S0/). I’m going to be visiting a lot of Caucus locations tonight, so maybe I’ll see you later. Thanks again.

| | Dear Fellow American,

Winston Churchill once described Russia as "a riddle, wrapped in a mystery, inside an enigma"--words that still ring true.

But given Russia's current war with Ukraine--and Russia's role in the shifting balance of power in today's world--a better understanding of Russia is critical.

Since Peter the Great, Russia's place among nations has only grown. As it transformed itself from a regional backwater to a great power, its politics and culture influenced significant events in our own history.

In the Cold War period between World War Two and the fall of the Soviet Union in 1991, American-Russian relations became the focus of world attention.

**The need for a better understanding of post-Cold War Russia, in light of its current importance and its long history as one of the world 's great powers, is why Hillsdale College has created a [FREE online video series on Russia](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=cf9dd249ff854531a012c96f540ce4ef&_e=f9ufg0IxnSKNdpK84rIuIwb9mdirhJmDhnit5Pl-is9WoqcBhFNlpUizmItQmspjWEyP9h78unlPwmcobRl0KbYsAxNw-xsYobsPLDT74NGNpmPA6TtQL7aFDCtEFKJ_We_Igsu6mHOL3wD8yQvo04N_I5jVGULjLb3SDwzOuay2S4hsFt80pOgQfPoOO5NF6fg5fHxEpOaiEoaNaYfefQwoNZWJmJH9n-G8GjuuMTMati_U0b_kjKBoCzRcba4pACto02QktRzKMGVbbXTP6HC0mOA1HqDsv6fqPy4aukT5d9YWfspBhi9Rgu5nv3vj5QgVmBH1LPtxv4A9TAkkiikj9h3H2w_2eQaPNIclFe4%3D). **

In our online video series, based on a recent conference held at Hillsdale College, you'll learn more about Russian history--including the "Greats" such as Peter and Catherine--with special attention to the Russian Revolution through the fall of the Soviet Union.

The video series also explores Russia's significant contributions to literature, through such authors as Dostoyevsky and Tolstoy--and to classical music, through such composers such as Tchaikovsky and Rachmaninoff.

**You 'll also gain a deeper understanding of Russia's enigmatic relationship with the West today, and about the causes and complications of the current Ukraine war. **

You can receive instant access to this free video series right now using this secure link:

[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/russia-cca/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=cf9dd249ff854531a012c96f540ce4ef&_e=f9ufg0IxnSKNdpK84rIuIwb9mdirhJmDhnit5Pl-is9WoqcBhFNlpUizmItQmspjWEyP9h78unlPwmcobRl0KbYsAxNw-xsYobsPLDT74NGNpmPA6TtQL7aFDCtEFKJ_We_Igsu6mHOL3wD8yQvo04N_I5jVGULjLb3SDwzOuay2S4hsFt80pOgQfPoOO5NF6fg5fHxEpOaiEoaNaYfeffVBpBRKGmeNj-Svd5g5u_HOwpq_xVLNCjQrTR_HRl67Sa7KGaBSu5ytYuN50QixbP2ajsdi3LGXNbW4oZmas9PkWhQ6zOHNzwqMV2J1GJ55Xak-xT-rqBVe9UPnRvl-Qg6pai39sVW1Fd2g3OzNFSE%3D)

I spent a lot of time writing it and did my best to make every word count. I write it with great sadness and astonishment, sadness for our country which I hold so dear, and astonishment at Joe Biden's desecration of the Oath of Office he took with his hand on the Bible in front of the world. **It has come to light that the Federal Bureau of Investigation has had 40 informants inside the Biden family over the past 15 years.** For 15 years, Credible Informants have been providing criminal information against the Biden's to FBI Field Offices across the country, and for 15 years, everytime the information has been brought to FBI HQ, the leadership of the FBI shuts it down. But it's not just the FBI, it's the Department of Justice as well. I heard sworn witness testimony that the Biden Bribery allegations on the FD-1023 Form were CREDIBLE, and that he referred the criminal matters originating from it to three separate U.S. Attorney's offices in Brookly, Manhattan and Delaware for further investigation. Then, just like at the FBI, nothing happened. **As I 've been saying since I started this investigation; the allegations about Joe Biden are being covered up... because they are TRUE!** While words don't have any meaning to the Left, they still mean something to me and the law in this country. **CONSPIRACY NOUN** con*spir*a*cy An agreement between two or more people to commit an illegal act, along with an intent to achieve the agreement's goal. disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY MIKE DUGAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
| | | [](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/8c30722d3644710666a6b3c4b83ff292/45443/c5160ff1b40b98ed3947229f28c3afba/72c4581861fd98aec3d6b838967d376c/45443)
---
, I wanted to take a couple of seconds to share more about my life, and why I’m running for Congress. I grew up in Georgia’s 3rd District, in Carrollton. I graduated from Bowdon High School, got a bachelor’s degree from West Georgia, and enlisted in the U.S. Army. I also met Misty, and this year we’re celebrating 37 years of marriage.
---
|
---
[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/8c30722d3644710666a6b3c4b83ff292/45443/c5160ff1b40b98ed3947229f28c3afba/fa794d2f71ac9f6fc3d6b838967d376c/45443)
---
|
---
I went back to West Georgia, got my Master’s Degree, and was commissioned as a Second Lt. in the Infantry. Eventually, I became an Army Ranger and Master Paratrooper. **I spent 20+ years in the Army and deployed to more than 32 countries... including Israel, and combat zones in Bosnia, Iraq, and Afghanistan. ** After retiring from the Army, my family and I moved back to Carrollton. We got involved in our community, and I joined RA-LIN & Associates as a local contractor. **When a seat in the Georgia Senate opened in 2013, I felt the call to serve again. I ran and won, and for a decade, we delivered one conservative victory after another.**
---
|
---
[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/8c30722d3644710666a6b3c4b83ff292/45443/c5160ff1b40b98ed3947229f28c3afba/15448a9c27ce5913c3d6b838967d376c/45443)
---
|
---
I wrote the 2021 Election Integrity Act, which made it easier to vote and harder for bad actors to cheat. I wrote the bill to get divisive concepts out of the classroom. I helped get Constitutional Carry over the finish line. And I championed the policies that have made Georgia the #1 state in the country to live, work, and raise a family. **I’ve spent my career taking action and delivering results. Now, I’m running for Congress because we need decisive leaders to undo the damage being done to our country.** **No one in this race has the experience I have when it comes to getting things done. ** **[That’s my message, and I’m asking for your help to share it far and wide before the Republican primary in May. Will you donate $50, $24, or even just $5 here?](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/8c30722d3644710666a6b3c4b83ff292/45443/c5160ff1b40b98ed3947229f28c3afba/1c963eb97a0ffc1bc3d6b838967d376c/45443)**
---
[**DONATE NOW**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/8c30722d3644710666a6b3c4b83ff292/45443/c5160ff1b40b98ed3947229f28c3afba/0157cd22ad57a7a2c3d6b838967d376c/45443)
---
This is a competitive race with multiple candidates running. We have the winning message, and I have the experience to deliver for Georgia’s 3rd District, but the reality is that reaching voters, running ads, and holding events all take money. A lot of it. **[So, we need to raise as much as we can, as soon as we can, to implement our campaign’s plan. If you’re ready for an Army Ranger, a proven conservative, and a decisive leader in Congress, I hope you’ll stand with us now. ](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/8c30722d3644710666a6b3c4b83ff292/45443/c5160ff1b40b98ed3947229f28c3afba/757b7ab05329eed3c3d6b838967d376c/45443)** Thank you for any reinforcements you can send. Let’s go.

I graduated from Bowdon High School, got a bachelor’s degree from West Georgia, and enlisted in the U.S. Army. Eventually, I became an Army Ranger and Master Paratrooper. I spent 20+ years in the Army and deployed to more than 32 countries... including Israel, and combat zones in Bosnia, Iraq, and Afghanistan. After retiring from the Army, my family and I moved back to Carrollton. We got involved in our community, and I joined RA-LIN & Associates as a local contractor. clean_body: I have breaking news to share with you... | | Friend, I have breaking news to share with you... We at America First Legal have just filed an absolutely momentous lawsuit in Maricopa County, Arizona against their elections officials for repeatedly and egregiously violating the State of Arizona’s election administration laws. The election interference and systematic election law violations we allege in Arizona are appalling, bone-chilling, and have the most serious consequences for every American. We all know what’s going on. That’s why we are taking action to expose and punish those responsible! strongly allege numerous serious violations and criminal activity, including:#1 - Maricopa County refuses to maintain the mandatory chain of custody for ballots.In 2022, these failures resulted in a discrepancy of over 25,000 votes – larger than the margin of victory in the state governor’s race#2 - Maricopa County ignores mandatory reconciliation procedures to track each ballot printed or issued to a voter. The law requires tracking and reconciling ballots cast and voters checked in to stop fraud, but the Defendants do not perform any reconciliation procedures at all#3 - Arizona law requires ballot drop boxes to be staffed by at least two election officials positioned close enough to view each person who deposits ballots into it.Maintaining an unstaffed drop box is a felony. However, Maricopa County maintains unstaffed, unsupervised ballot drop boxes, facilitating illegal ballot harvesting For many years now, the Maricopa County Board of Supervisors and the County Recorder have consistently failed to lawfully administer elections. We believe these individuals are fully aware of their election law violations.Make no mistake: Our lawsuit has been filed to prevent the November 5, 2024, election from being tainted with the same mistakes and maladministration that occurred during the 2020 and 2022 elections and to prevent election interference from occurring.Thank you for your support of our mission and historic legal actions here! Here's my official update, where we are today, and my best appeal for February.
Hi, Friend, Andrew here from Bob Lorinser for Congress. I have some encouraging news to share with you.
**A Campaign Update:**
Our team is growing, and our momentum is building. Our supporters are becoming more excited about the probability of victory in the primary and challenging Rep. Jack Bergman this November. Bob and Peggy are working tirelessly, traveling up to four times a week to visit every corner of this massive district and talk to voters.
Our field plan for direct voter contact is coming together, volunteers are gearing up to knock on doors, and we're gathering more than the required amount of signatures to show strength when Bob officially files to be on the ballot this April.
_**No one will outwork us. No one will outorganize us.**_
_**[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79842645/457654582/-1092700192?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MWJlYThmMC05M2Q1LWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DgYal94K53MZOw3pio2XXo3r_r_OuzjR6gE1XtGSBGo=&emci=c9df3a13-8cd5-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=61bea8f0-93d5-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=15167427)**_
**, Rep. Jack Bergman has never faced a second-time challenger.** The last repeat Democratic candidate in MI01 lost by just a half percentage point, nearly unseating the GOP incumbent. And, as biased as I am, it's hard to deny that Dr. Bob is one of the most qualified candidates this district has ever seen.
Last cycle, despite unfavorable redistricting, our campaign moved the needle for Democrats in Northern Michigan and the UP by 5 points.
But we're not done yet!
We have an election to win, and with your help, Bob Lorinser isn't just running; he's demonstrating a real chance of victory against Trumpism in rural Michigan.
**The challenge before us is significant, but I've never seen Dr. Bob more energized to take on Bergman.**
Bob offers the strongest, most viable candidacy and the greatest chance to retire him, but we must keep the momentum going. As we approach the end of the month -- on the day of the Presidential Primary -- we're reminded that _our_ primary is inching closer, and every contribution has a significant impact.
Our books for February close in two days, and I'm asking for your help. We have a massive direct voter contact program to fund, yard signs to buy, and our expanding infrastructure requires more resources. Let's make sure Rep. Bergman faces the political challenge of a lifetime.
Bob is fighting for universal healthcare, affordable childcare, education, and housing. He's fighting for livable wages, women's rights, labor reform, environmental protections, and a tax system that benefits everyone, not just the ultra-wealthy.
We need you in our corner to take our fight to Washington, and we're grateful for your support. If you've donated recently, thank you. If you're unable to contribute right now, we understand, and we still thank you for your support.
If you're ready to join our grassroots, rural movement, please consider a recurring contribution at **[drbob.me/aboutbob](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79842646/457654589/1886035588?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MWJlYThmMC05M2Q1LWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DgYal94K53MZOw3pio2XXo3r_r_OuzjR6gE1XtGSBGo=&emci=c9df3a13-8cd5-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=61bea8f0-93d5-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=15167427)**. Thank you.
This moment in our country is profound, and now, more than ever, we need serious leadership.
Yours,
Andrew

body:
It’s no secret that Congress is broken, and has been for years. A big part of the reason for that is lack of accountability. | | | | | I know political emails can be annoying, but it’s the best way for me to share my vision for the future and keep you up to date on the campaign: if you wish to unsubscribe, click [here](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/unsubscribe?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=266d823a9c&t=b&e=26f66c7cbd&c=605eb4be38).
---
[](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=d58531fb3c&e=26f66c7cbd)
Friend,
It’s no secret that Congress is broken, and has been for years. A big part of the reason for that is lack of accountability.
With more than 90 percent of House incumbents being re-elected year after year, the vast majority of Congressional incumbents know there is little chance they will ever pay a price for their failure to respond to citizens’ concerns.
That’s why I support term limits. Serving in Congress is supposed to be a public service, not a cushy job for life or a retirement plan.
[](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=a6ca3733b5&e=26f66c7cbd)
Term limits for Members of Congress are supported by wide majorities of citizens across all demographic groups.
Caps on time served would dramatically counter-balance all the current advantages held by incumbents, and more competition in congressional districts is simply good for democracy. Being new to Congress, you’d think Hillary Scholten would want to make Congress more responsive to the needs of her constituents. Regrettably she has not endorsed term limits. We have the opportunity to make a change in MI03’s representative stance on this issue in November.
| [DONATE](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=c8e9f1207f&e=26f66c7cbd)
---
“There’s room for debate about the ideal length of time for term limits, but I support a reasonable cap that properly balances the need for institutional memory and competence while ensuring we are not represented by careerist dinosaurs who are no longer responsive to the people or a lobbyist-state that benefits from a representative body without experience. I remain optimistic that in the new 119th Congress, with new members like me, term limits will receive the support citizens demand and deserve. To get there, I need your support!
If you’re able, [please consider donating $5, $10, or $25 to my campaign so that we can spread the message](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=106072f369&e=26f66c7cbd) of change to voters in West Michigan.
Here to serve,**Paul Hudson**

| | Dear Friend,

Exodus features some of the most memorable events in the Bible, with the burning bush, the plagues, Moses parting the Red Sea, and the Ten Commandments.

I've known the basic outline of the second book of the Bible since I was a kid.

But understanding the symbolism and subtlety God used as He freed the Israelites has deepened my awe at His wisdom and goodness. Each warning to the Egyptians built upon the last, and with every plague God gave Pharaoh the chance to repent and avoid disaster.

All the while, God showed patience with His sometimes hesitant servant Moses and His people, the Israelites.

To reveal this fascinating history and deepen your understanding of God's mercy, we've produced our online course, "**The Exodus Story** ," which is available now.

[](http://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyUkUuO2zAMQE8j72yIlBLXCy8G8LibzKRogXYpyBLtCNDHkOR-bl-kSQ8w20fgkQ_88abetPMubu860Lj6rHJRUaub876l38kepV2PaNufqJCjbDm22Cto7MhhsFI2NELPB376BGdobqM9CVhXbYbByIX0umi7SAFwEgZAE2_cePdwxB56CSg7a_oz9UDLchpQDwuTXHvKtVszkU1BR-vdQrn-ybSnXDuTQuPHW617YeKF4cxwTtG7SN397GK1p47swXDOtLlSKTOcHzFMzMUwMXFAAe8cJV4Qpuv0-vqN4fmoQZV0ZENMTHtOZSdTXdyeo0DWHYGJiYJ2_gmNDrt2W7zjx4onT7FSrExM3_Fy_XxVX17a-fK1_V_f5NHuv5z3rpx7Jvl2d_5rqx_4w98AAAD__6_gkNc)
Professor Justin Jackson returns to lead us through the intricacies of the Exodus narrative, explaining how God used each warning and plague, to draw His people into trust and to give the Egyptians a chance to repent.

**You can watch the video trailer for the course and register today using the secure link below:**

[**[https://online.hillsdale.edu/register/exodus](http://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyUkUuO2zAMQE8j72yIlBLXCy8G8LibzKRogXYpyBLtCNDHkOR-bl-kSQ8w20fgkQ_88abetPMubu860Lj6rHJRUaub876l38kepV2PaNufqJCjbDm22Cto7MhhsFI2NELPB376BGdobqM9CVhXbYbByIX0umi7SAFwEgZAE2_cePdwxB56CSg7a_oz9UDLchpQDwuTXHvKtVszkU1BR-vdQrn-ybSnXDuTQuPHW617YeKF4cxwTtG7SN397GK1p47swXDOtLlSKTOcHzFMzMUwMXFAAe8cJV4Qpuv0-vqN4fmoQZV0ZENMTHtOZSdTXdyeo0DWHYGJiYJ2_gmNDrt2W7zjx4onT7FSrExM3_Fy_XxVX17a-fK1_V_f5NHuv5z3rpx7Jvl2d_5rqx_4w98AAAD__6_gkNc)**](http://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyUkLuO3SAQQL8Gd7aYgXtZFy5W8rrKbiKlSIkwjH2ReFiA8_j7yNn7A2nPSGfmzI93_W588Gn_MJGmLRRdqk5GP3wIPf3O7qz9dibX_0SNHGXPsUeloXMTh9FJ2dEEio_89gJ36B6TVNuq0MJo1hcOtAIRCLqB5RzVhrLz0-XhiAqUBJSDs-pOCmhdbyOacWWSm0ClDVshcjma5IJfqbQ_hY5c2mBz7ML0aO2oTLwyXBguOQWfaLjOrs4EGsidDJdCu6-NCsPlM4aJpVomZg4o4IOjxC8I89f57e07w_vZoq75LJaYmI-S60G2-bQ_R5GcPyMTM0XjwxNaEw_j93ThzxVPnlOj1JiYWzE-UEH97bXvyuSOXz4EX--KSb5fpn9F7T--_zcAAP__c7KOtA)

My name is Tony Villarreal. I’m the former Mayor of Fort Stockton and former Edwards and Pecos County Commissioner.
When this important race first started last year, like many people I saw all the attention Colin Allred was getting and I put my support behind him in the Democratic primary for the US Senate...
Now, a lot has changed since that time. I have pulled my support of Allred and have thrown my full support behind Thierry Tchenko.
**WHY?** There are a number of reasons: We only hear from Colin when he wants money (texts and emails). He hasn’t visited our communities or talked to the people he hopes to represent in the Senate.
**Thierry on the other hand is showing up, doing the work, building a truly diverse coalition and showing that his campaign isn’t about himself, but about serving Texans.**
He is showing up all across the state in communities that haven’t gotten attention in a long time. He’s not just talking to people, but actually listening to what they have to say. At times being confronted by individuals from the other side of the aisle but nevertheless treating them with respect and dignity. I saw this firsthand during his 20-county Rural West Texas Tour in January.
If you’re looking for someone who can actually win in November, I can’t recommend enough giving Thierry a closer look. I have and I’m so glad I did.
[**If you’re in a position to do so, join me in supporting Thierry with a donation of $30 or more today.**](https://tchenkofortexas.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=93f02de4b9a588e8269491419&id=240e9fb6fd&e=b8ba94fd9b)
Texas, and America, will be a better place with Thierry Tchenko serving in the US Senate.
Thank you,Tony

| | The Georgia State Senate Education and Youth Committee voted to advance SB 88, the state’s proposed "Don't Say Gay" bill. **It was wrong in Florida and it is wrong in Georgia. ** If this bill becomes law, private school teachers would be prohibited from discussing anything related to gender identity or sexual orientation without the expressed written consent by parents — including the fact that transgender and nonbinary people _exist_. It also paves the way for public school districts to force teachers to out transgender students to their parents. **This kind of educational censorship is anti-democratic. Full stop. ** And when the Committee passed this bill, they did so without hearing a _single word_ of testimony from voters who oppose the bill — instead only allowing testimony from those in favor. **Fair Fight Action’s vision for Georgia — and our democracy — includes _everyone_. That means making sure that our laws protect our queer, trans, and nonbinary neighbors, not target them.** It’s the same lawmakers restricting the freedom to vote who are also attacking the LGBTQ+ community. When we have the freedom to make our voices heard at the ballot box, we have more power to protect LGBTQ+ rights and stop anti-LGBTQ+ extremism. Together with our friends at Georgia Equality and other allies, Fair Fight Action will continue working to organize against this bill and the slate of anti-LGBTQ+ bills being pushed this session — and create a democracy for _all_ Georgians. More soon, Fair Fight Action P.S. [**It’s going to take all of us working together to build a more inclusive democracy. clean_body: It’s going to take all of us working together to build a more inclusive democracy. | | | The Georgia State Senate Education and Youth Committee voted to advance SB 88, the state’s proposed "Don't Say Gay" bill. It was wrong in Florida and it is wrong in Georgia. If this bill becomes law, private school teachers would be prohibited from discussing anything related to gender identity or sexual orientation without the expressed written consent by parents — including the fact that transgender and nonbinary people exist. It also paves the way for public school districts to force teachers to out transgender students to their parents. This kind of educational censorship is anti-democratic. Full stop. And when the Committee passed this bill, they did so without hearing a single word of testimony from voters who oppose the bill — instead only allowing testimony from those in favor. Fair Fight Action’s vision for Georgia — and our democracy — includes everyone. That means making sure that our laws protect our queer, trans, and nonbinary neighbors, not target them. It’s the same lawmakers restricting the freedom to vote who are also attacking the LGBTQ+ community. When we have the freedom to make our voices heard at the ballot box, we have more power to protect LGBTQ+ rights and stop anti-LGBTQ+ extremism. Together with our friends at Georgia Equality and other allies, Fair Fight Action will continue working to organize against this bill and the slate of anti-LGBTQ+ bills being pushed this session — and create a democracy for all Georgians. Friend, Kirsten Gillibrand has promised results for families — and she's working hard to get the job done.
She’s recently won justice reform for survivors of sexual abuse in our armed forces, expanded health care protections for veterans and passed legislation to crack down on interstate gun trafficking. She spent _years_ fighting to make these bills become law — but she isn't slowing down for even a moment.
**_Now,_** she's leading the charge to lower the cost of living, secure paid family leave for all Americans and finally certify the Equal Rights Amendment, which would give us a legal basis to restore reproductive rights across the nation.

Fellow American: A Massachusetts school has censored a seventh grader for wearing a shirt that expresses biological truth. Throughout the entire nation, a debate is raging on the very nature of what it means to be human. What makes a person a man? A woman? Our Constitution guarantees freedom of thought—the freedom to share your beliefs. **Twelve-year-old Liam Morrison’s school has decided that debate is out—and government orthodoxy is in.** Liam, a 12-year-old student at Nichols Middle School in Middleborough, Massachusetts, quietly observed how the school proclaimed loudly that a person’s feelings, not their biology, determines their sex and gender. Liam holds different beliefs. Informed by a scientific understanding of biology (and backed by millennia of human history), he believes that there only two sexes (male and female) and that a person’s gender is inseparable from their sex. **So, one day Liam wore a shirt to school that says, “There are only two genders.”** The principal of the school, along with a school counselor, pulled Liam out of class and ordered him to remove his shirt or go home. Liam politely declined and was sent home. **Public school officials cannot censor a 7th grader’s speech by forcing him to remove a shirt that states scientific fact. This is a gross violation of the First Amendment.** **[Please stand with this brave 7th grader as he challenges his school’s violation of free speech. Sign our pledge to show that Liam isn’t the only one who is standing up for these truths.](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM1MDI1NTcxMSIsInJxIjoiMDItYjI0MDU4LWRkNzQ5MTFhMTIzZTRmZmJhNmE1MmYzNGI1NDNjODNkIiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjEiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL3B4bC5pc3QvaHV0dXFsaGZ1Zj9zcmM9RkFMUjQ2ODcyIn0/2ZNDMv7tpepbXzea10_WJA)**
---

---
**“They completely took away my ability to have a different opinion than they wanted me to have,” Liam says.** This case isn’t just about a shirt.
* **It’s about a public school telling Liam** —and thereby all other students—that he can’t wear a shirt with a message that’s important to him unless it’s the same opinion as the government’s.
* **It’s about a public school trying to force a student** to forfeit his free speech when he walks into the school building.
* **It’s about a public school imposing its view on students** —and censoring students who disagree.

“The school is talking about this issue all the time,” ADF Senior Counsel Tyson Langhofer, who is defending Liam, says, “and all Liam wanted to do was express his opinion, which is actually shared by a lot of his classmates.” After the school punished Liam for wearing the shirt, he wore another shirt to protest the school’s censorship that said: “There are censored genders.” Again, the school told him to take off the shirt. That’s when Liam and his family decided to ask Alliance Defending Freedom and the Massachusetts Family Institute to take legal action.
---

---
“I don’t complain when I see pride flags and diversity posters hung throughout the school,” Liam told a meeting of the Middleboro School Committee in April, after he was punished the first time. “Others have a right to their beliefs just like I do.” **The First Amendment protects people of all beliefs, especially people that disagree with the government. If you only have freedom to agree with those in power, you don’t have freedom at all.** Across the nation, government officials are trying to silence views that differ from radical gender ideology. And it’s falling to brave 12-year-olds like Liam to stand in opposition and not affirm lies when school officials, who should be modeling adulthood, have failed students. **[Will you join Liam today?](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM1MDI1NTcxMSIsInJxIjoiMDItYjI0MDU4LWRkNzQ5MTFhMTIzZTRmZmJhNmE1MmYzNGI1NDNjODNkIiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjQiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL3B4bC5pc3QvaHV0dXFsaGZ1Zj9zcmM9RkFMUjQ2ODcyIn0/1ImnW3ucVu9B1A7oMVRgpA)**

Friend, I have breaking news to share with you... We at America First Legal have just filed an **absolutely momentous** lawsuit in Maricopa County, Arizona against their elections officials for repeatedly and egregiously violating the State of Arizona’s election administration laws. The election interference and systematic election law violations we allege in Arizona are appalling, bone-chilling, and have the most serious consequences for every American. # [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79855391/457684586/-822722586?refcode=AU_NJB_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20240227_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjQwNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmY2Q1YzE2MS1hM2Q1LWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=x01KS0MJci_NMfRSwADwHFfqliaucX5J1VZDv0HtKto=)

The choice of when and how to start your family, should be just that — **a choice.** Yet my colleagues on the other side of the aisle are working hard to take away that choice and roll back reproductive freedom for millions of people across the nation. Last year, **125 of my Republican colleagues** co-sponsored legislation that declared life begins at conception without ANY exceptions for in vitro fertilization treatments. Recently, the anti-choice right has gone even further, with a ruling from the Supreme Court of Alabama saying that the frozen embryos used in IVF are “unborn children,'' putting the procedure at risk. Hundreds of thousands of families across the nation use IVF to begin their journey of parenthood, and I promise, as long as I’m in this seat, I won’t stop fighting to protect your reproductive freedoms. # Important Campaign Announcement
---
|
---
| | | Dear Friends,

Today, I am suspending my campaign for the Presidency of the United States of America and offering my endorsement and unwavering support for President Trump. I would like to thank my family, friends, campaign team, 80,000 plus financial supporters, and the hundreds of volunteers who helped share my vision. Without your efforts, prayers, love, and generosity, none of this would have been possible.

When I began this journey, it was with a message in my heart that our country needs to awaken to the fact that the unsustainable deficit spending and debt path we are on will undoubtedly lead us to a generational economic disruption. I believe that we can get off that path and begin a journey to balance the federal budget by transforming and demonopolizing the healthcare system which has been bankrupting our nation. I also felt deeply that as bad as the U.S. fiscal and monetary policy is, the political corruption and cultural divide in our country is an even greater threat. Throughout my campaign, I have seen our party struggle to find a place for a new vision while weighing the corrupt allegations and indictments against President Trump. He will need everyone’s support, and he will have mine moving forward.

While it is time for me to go back to my family, business, and church and care for the responsibilities I have been given, I remain steadfast in my commitment to my plans for the economy, border security, and healthcare. I look forward to considering other ways I can make an impact and promote my policy positions. Thank you again for being with us on this journey. Let’s continue to pray for our nation, and our leaders. When we look to each other for wisdom and strength, our future can be better than we can imagine. I look forward to seeing what tomorrow holds.
---
| Sincerely,

Dear Friend,

Since the beginning, the Let Us Worship movement has always rented production equipment in each city where we held revivals. But while this allowed us to forgo a huge financial investment in our fledgling ministry, we experienced the clear and unfortunate downsides. We've experienced vendors _CANCEL on us _at the last last-minute after learning our beliefs. We've been reliant on thousands of vendors in hundreds of cities and spent millions of dollars over the past few years. For this year's Kingdom to the Capitol Tour, we are responsible for ALL costs associated with this year's revivals. We believe now is the time, and __**WE'RE MAKING A LEAP OF FAITH.**__ Starting today, we are launching a campaign to raise $180,000 for sound equipment, production equipment, and a truck to carry it around the country. This is an investment into the future of the Let Us Worship movement. We want you to be a part of this—LITERALLY. We're getting the truck wrapped in REVIVAL graphics, and we are including the names of those who made it all possible. Anyone who contributes $100 and above is automatically eligible to have their name printed on the bus. A part of YOU could be traveling this country to bring revival!! We're running holding this drawing for a week because we've got to get this bus wrapped and ready for our next stops in Florida, South Carolina, and Kentucky!

# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79857406/457688560/1033648996?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDU2NTciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiODg1YTAwMGMtYTZkNS1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=d-vdKCrroAX3MigY18SfqHIpWQIXSOqMobHTucJjzS4=)
Peter, our primary is only one week away, and I need you to see this:

**_NBC News_ just declared that nine California races could decide the battle for the House in November. Our race in CA-47 made the list.**

Here’s a quote that really stood out from _NBC_ : “this district has been a bellwether for national trends; if Republicans win it, they could be in a good position to keep the House majority.”

With our primary one week away, all eyes will be on us to see how this campaign and our grassroots team steps up. **That is why our final end-of-month deadline before the election is so critical.**

As a front-line Republican and steadfast ally of President Trump, Democrats have long targeted me for electoral defeat in November's election. They don't like debating with me with regard to important legislation in the House, and **they cannot stand how we're helping the American public come to the realization that Democrats are more focused on partisanship than getting things done for the American people**.

So, if you agree with me that:

subject: Stopping the extremist attempts to ban IVF
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY SHARICE FOR CONGRESS
body:
125 House Republicans have sponsored legislation that would ban IVF in every state in the country.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79858453/457691492/-240735101?refcode=email-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NTY0N2YwZS1hN2Q1LWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=97JvlTl-eTK39dg2Zmn_pCXPRlR-Re-ki4PY8cPbVhY=) It’s bad enough that people in Alabama are now banned from using IVF to conceive a child. But it gets even worse: _**125 House Republicans have sponsored legislation that would ban IVF in every state in the country.**_ I’m going to fight hard to make sure they don’t succeed. And more than that, I’m going to work to restore the reproductive rights and freedoms that have been under attack ever since Roe v. Wade was overturned. And I’m asking you to join me. At this point, it feels like everyone around me is talking about what's happening in Alabama, but in case you missed it, here's the short version: The Alabama Supreme Court has ruled – citing "the wrath of God" – that embryos are children. The result? IVF clinics in the state suspended services, leaving people who desperately want children in limbo. **This is a dangerous precedent for:**
1. **Blocking access to reproductive care** – not only has this threatened IVF, but by declaring embryos are children, the Alabama Supreme Court has also opened the door to banning certain forms of birth control.
2. **Erasing the lines between church and state** – this is a foundational part of our democracy, and I find it deeply disturbing that judges would make decisions based on the Bible instead of the law and science.

As a woman, as someone with friends who've gone through IVF, as a combat vet who put her life on the line for our freedoms... this is SO personal to me. The anti-choice Far Right was never going to just stop at abortion. And Brian Fitzpatrick has shown he is completely unwilling to stand up to the MAGA forces who will absolutely push their patriarchal, anti-choice agenda on all of us. Like hell am I going to stand by and let that happen. [I fought for our reproductive freedom overseas, on the battlefield. Now I'm ready to fight for it in the halls of Congress. Friend,
This weekend, I traveled to Ukraine with a Congressional delegation on the second anniversary of Vladimir Putin's lawless invasion.
While there, we met with President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and other key Ukrainian leaders. It was a profound, meaningful experience.
Against all odds, the Ukrainian people have held the line for two years in their fight for democracy and freedom. They have sacrificed their lives and won battle after battle.
If we abandon them now, it will be one of the most shameful things we have done in my lifetime.
President Zelenskyy told me that his country could win this war with more assistance from the United States -- and Putin is relying on Congress' political dysfunction to help him win in Ukraine.
It’s time for us to do our part.
[https://youtu.be/BCV0pMNVElc] [https://youtu.be/BCV0pMNVElc] Today, I joined Morning Joe to talk about this trip to Ukraine and the work ahead to help the Ukrainian people. [https://youtu.be/BCV0pMNVElc] Click here to watch the clip now >> [https://youtu.be/BCV0pMNVElc] [https://youtu.be/BCV0pMNVElc]
The Senate already passed a bipartisan bill that would provide critical funding for Ukraine. More than two-thirds of the Senate voted for it. House Republicans need to stop their obstruction and let this bill pass.
I won’t stop working to support the Ukrainian people in their fight for democracy. Their fight is our fight.
It is the fight of our lifetimes. Thank you, friend, for being part of the battle for democracy around the world.
Michael

name: Katie Porter
subject: I'm personally reaching out to you
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Senate
body:
I wanted to cut through the noise and write to you today
Derek, with just seven days until the primary election, I want to cut through the noise and explain where things stand in this race.
Last week two new polls dropped. The first, showed us in third place, behind Republican Steve Garvey by six points. **The second, conducted later when voters had more time to see our ads, showed us one point ahead of Garvey and in second place.** These polls also show that large margins of voters—nearly 20% are still undecided about who to support.
So while this forward movement is a promising sign, Schiff saw the exact same poll. He has been spending millions of dollars to try and *boost* Garvey into the second place spot so that he has an easy-to-defeat general election opponent.
**Both Schiff and his super PAC are spending heavily on Fox News to propel Garvey into second place, despite Schiff’s previous calls for advertisers to boycott the network.**
To be frank, Schiff and the super PACs supporting him are just drowning us out. As of yesterday, he reportedly spent $22.3 million on advertising in the past six weeks, **has twice as much cash on hand as us** , and is outspending us three to one on TV.

name: Lucas Tyree Kunce
subject: I just filed to put my name on the ballot for Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri
body:
This is an important milestone for our grassroots campaign.
#
Hey Peter, it’s Lucas Kunce with an exciting update.
**Just moments ago in Jeff City, I officially filed the paperwork to put my name on the ballot to represent Missouri in the United States Senate.**
Being here to make this official is special to me because on the other side of town, there’s an old cracked street I used to call home. So before I share more about why I got into this race, please give me a moment to reintroduce myself.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44004?refcode=em20240227-4926&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=4926%2E614464%2E9w_C1e)
**[CONTRIBUTE NOW](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44004?refcode=em20240227-4926&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=4926%2E614464%2E9w_C1e)**
As a kid from a working class neighborhood in Jeff City, my family struggled. My parents were already living paycheck-to-paycheck, and when my little sister was born with a heart condition, they were bankrupted by medical bills.
But we were never alone. Friends, neighbors, people in our community who had no more than we did all came together to support my family. They helped me go to college, and after that I joined the Marines to honor everything they did for us.
Between tours in Iraq and Afghanistan, one of the hardest things was coming home and seeing what was happening in my old neighborhood. It was a community picked for parts — the local corner store boarded up, our family’s first house in the neighborhood bulldozed to the ground.
While all of us risked our lives building up towns like Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Herat, career politicians and the corporate elites backing them let our country waste away. They spent 20 years and trillions of dollars on pointless forever wars and defense contractors, but could never seem to figure out how to invest even a fraction of that amount back into our own communities.
**After decades of corrupt politicians using their power to control us and massive corporations stripping our communities for parts, I’m running for U.S. Senate because I want everyday Missourians — people who know how to take care of each other — to call the shots in our country.**
Together, we can stop handing out money for Wall Street and forever wars, and we can create a Marshall Plan for the Midwest to rebuild our forgotten towns and cities here at home. We can build an economy that puts workers and small businesses in charge — one that puts America first in the next generation of energy, semiconductors, and supply chain independence.
We can end the filibuster, codify Roe, and stop the Big Brother attacks on reproductive rights by control-obsessed politicians in Missouri and nationwide. And we can finally hold our politicians accountable by abolishing corporate PACs and banning insider trading for members of Congress.
**Today was an important milestone for our campaign, but there will be many more between now and November —[and I’ll need your support every step of the way.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44004?refcode=em20240227-4926&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=4926%2E614464%2E9w_C1e)**
**[CONTRIBUTE NOW](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44004?refcode=em20240227-4926&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=4926%2E614464%2E9w_C1e)**
Thank you for helping us build this people-powered movement, Peter. If we keep working together, I know we can flip Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat and take back power for working people this November.
Now that it’s official — let’s get to work!
Lucas Tyree Kunce

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lk-email-footer?refcode=em20240227-4926-footer&t=5&refcode2=4926_614464_9w_C1e&akid=4926%2E614464%2E9w_C1e)**

Provides that it is the policy of the Commonwealth to safeguard all individuals within the Commonwealth from unlawful discrimination in employment and in places of public accommodation because of such individual's ethnic origin and prohibits such discrimination. The bill also adds victims who are intentionally selected because of their ethnic origin to the categories of victims whose intentional selection for a hate crime involving assault, assault and battery, or trespass for the purpose of damaging another's property results in a higher criminal penalty for the offense. The bill also provides that no provider or user of an interactive computer service on the Internet shall be liable for any action voluntarily taken by it in good faith to restrict access to material that the provider or user considers to be intended to incite hatred on the basis of ethnic origin.
[H.B. 62](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XtrhacWbEvslC4i31N2mPSaX_DzLI-eVxZSgJvOlIe_hoLjXzvG0V3hXaD5woGloFrR89xYoYri6c_Xt0vgv9vbWqoG-MuziAL0t591E1C44SBbuHDXYNk4GDj2XBuCkT2HqlH_uHGSUfR1kzlBIRONRopY9YBSukdcN8KXZ3JntE87DiULS-x4gMY3X3tq1OnM_O3Af0Is=&c=G5xXfAZVXf9oeNikmRRglTLfw9p3j92B_tf5Y1r1n5umF3VW0edxqg==&ch=lTJ_3T64CE5cOxh9deXS0Qg-LT6tuZNd72lkecb5DR2c5mL_4ZG1pA==) Patron: Campbell Animal Cruelty Conviction List established. Requires the Superintendent of State Police to establish no later than January 1, 2027, and to maintain the Animal Cruelty Conviction List and to make the List available to the public on the website of the Department of State Police. The bill specifies that the List include the names of persons convicted of certain felony animal cruelty offenses on or after July 1, 2024. The bill requires persons convicted of any such offense to pay a fee of $50 per conviction to fund the maintenance of the List. The bill also requires the Department to remove a person's name and information from the List 15 years after its listing if he has no additional felony conviction of any such offense.
[H.B. 173](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XtrhacWbEvslC4i31N2mPSaX_DzLI-eVxZSgJvOlIe_hoLjXzvG0V_-pi6ZjLfafeMDd06WljILTGHdKSgI_F3_Bpg2NrAtu7glAVFHzHL1HN3sAl8dHmjrwk7tqzA7e5LFnh9I8BraK4_rGJKkIyG7bVTOh6sVxhRsp2LMux9Mg88twYNQDh6RsGzcNERXUynM652PaMJo=&c=G5xXfAZVXf9oeNikmRRglTLfw9p3j92B_tf5Y1r1n5umF3VW0edxqg==&ch=lTJ_3T64CE5cOxh9deXS0Qg-LT6tuZNd72lkecb5DR2c5mL_4ZG1pA==) Patron: Simon Manufacture, import, sale, transfer, or possession of plastic firearms and unfinished frames or receivers and unserialized firearms prohibited; penalties. Creates a Class 5 felony for any person who knowingly manufactures or assembles, imports, purchases, sells, transfers, or possesses any firearm that, after removal of all parts other than a major component, as defined in the bill, is not detectable as a firearm when subjected to inspection by the types of detection devices, including X-ray machines, commonly used at airports, government buildings, schools, correctional facilities, and other locations for security screening. The bill updates language regarding the types of detection devices that are used at such locations for detecting plastic firearms. Under current law, it is unlawful to manufacture, import, sell, transfer, or possess any plastic firearm and a violation is punishable as a Class 5 felony. The bill also creates a Class 1 misdemeanor, which is punishable as a Class 4 felony for a second or subsequent offense, making it unlawful for any person to knowingly import, purchase, sell, offer for sale, or transfer ownership of any completed or unfinished frame or receiver, unless the completed or unfinished frame or receiver (i) is deemed to be a firearm pursuant to federal law and (ii) is imprinted with a valid serial number. The bill creates a Class 1 misdemeanor, which is punishable as a Class 4 felony for a second or subsequent offense, making it unlawful for any person to knowingly possess a firearm that it not imprinted with a valid serial number, or to manufacture or assemble, cause to be manufactured or assembled, import, purchase, sell, offer for sale, or transfer ownership of any firearm that is not imprinted with a valid serial number. The portions of the bill prohibiting unfinished frames or receivers and unserialized firearms have a delayed effective date of January 1, 2025.
[H.B. 183](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XtrhacWbEvslC4i31N2mPSaX_DzLI-eVxZSgJvOlIe_hoLjXzvG0V_-pi6ZjLfafR1saD6IMCQvvnonfctOLIwq__ihWTrLeGbxBnqmBCrZc7_fDu4RBc9uasPi5Nr-uEaVgfsX6mTUG_PzQOI97GqmMVU-6u6k_oiAAOAEVpYC8rxKNlDCMIJN94QYAJtrNxeI1ZQ3DH5Q=&c=G5xXfAZVXf9oeNikmRRglTLfw9p3j92B_tf5Y1r1n5umF3VW0edxqg==&ch=lTJ_3T64CE5cOxh9deXS0Qg-LT6tuZNd72lkecb5DR2c5mL_4ZG1pA==) Patron: Simon Storage of firearms in a residence where a minor or person prohibited from possessing a firearm is present; penalty. Requires any person who possesses a firearm in a residence where such person knows that a minor under 18 years of age or a person who is prohibited by law from possessing a firearm is present to store such firearm and the ammunition for such firearm in a locked container, compartment, or cabinet that is inaccessible to such minor or prohibited person. The bill provides that a violation is a Class 4 misdemeanor. The bill exempts (i) any person in lawful possession of a firearm who carries such firearm on or about his person and (ii) the storage of antique firearms and provides that the lawful authorization of a minor to access a firearm is not a violation of the bill's provisions. The bill also requires firearm dealers to post a notice stating such firearm storage requirements and the penalty for improperly storing such firearms.

Makes it a Class 1 misdemeanor for any person to knowingly possess in or transport into the building of any hospital that provides mental health services or developmental services in the Commonwealth, including an emergency department or other facility rendering emergency medical care, any (i) firearm or other weapon designed or intended to propel a missile or projectile of any kind; (ii) knife, except a pocket knife having a folding metal blade of less than three inches; or (iii) other dangerous weapon, including explosives and stun weapons. Patron: McClure Commission on Electric Utility Regulation; evaluation of infrastructure necessary for electric vehicle charging facilities. Directs the Commission on Electric Utility Regulation (the Commission) to evaluate the design and deployment of the electrical distribution infrastructure necessary to support the installation of electric vehicle charging facilities in new developments consisting of single-family and multifamily residential units. The bill requires the Commission to engage representatives from the residential and commercial development industries, private sector utility consultants, and other stakeholders.

Patron: Carr Housing; Zoning for Housing Production Fund created; affordable dwelling unit policy incentives; report. Creates the Zoning for Housing Production Program to be administered by the Department of Housing and Community Development (the Department). To be eligible for a grant from the Program, a locality is required to make a change to its zoning policies to allow for by-right development that is expected to further the goal of creating and maintaining mixed-income communities, affordable housing, and moderately priced housing, as those terms are defined in the bill. The Department of Housing and Community Development is required to establish certain guidelines and to notify the localities of the existence and purpose of the Program no later than September 1, 2024. The bill has an expiration date of July 1, 2027.

| [H.B. 81](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XtrhacWbEvslC4i31N2mPSaX_DzLI-eVxZSgJvOlIe_hoLjXzvG0VyBX1q3xnjEq59938i2zAgULMwc_7l_SxjK02GU0qTrTC4-b3GXmjAFnYzESq8CHlUj6C4LTUsZI4iXg3cz3OcPcMHy_ys89hKJP-skNPaFPALEgeKd_DXyvUUcD4vh5jmnKWNf0wdvpBUVQ2q0643E=&c=G5xXfAZVXf9oeNikmRRglTLfw9p3j92B_tf5Y1r1n5umF3VW0edxqg==&ch=lTJ_3T64CE5cOxh9deXS0Qg-LT6tuZNd72lkecb5DR2c5mL_4ZG1pA==) Patron: Simon Common-law crime of suicide. Abolishes the common-law crime of suicide. Suicide is currently a common-law crime in Virginia, although there is no statutorily prescribed punishment.
[H.B. 158](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XtrhacWbEvslC4i31N2mPSaX_DzLI-eVxZSgJvOlIe_hoLjXzvG0VxVRrpVWDcQUjttpJ9QUQ0XlqKFqW4eJEhlDRBOpA_nW2Ugl8qU3FWKTKeLTrY8WXb_3Pd8gB-0yiIlPp1RcZg8QWl1XtfwOvfNK99TMbH_t6S2DqMv5Qw6AKFE01VsozFZiW93dIqemSSKe7HHvjJ8=&c=G5xXfAZVXf9oeNikmRRglTLfw9p3j92B_tf5Y1r1n5umF3VW0edxqg==&ch=lTJ_3T64CE5cOxh9deXS0Qg-LT6tuZNd72lkecb5DR2c5mL_4ZG1pA==) Patron: McClure Firearm locking device required for sale or transfer of firearm; warning against accessibility to children; penalty. Makes it a Class 3 misdemeanor for any licensed manufacturer, licensed importer, or licensed dealer to sell, deliver, or transfer any firearm to any person other than a licensed manufacturer, licensed importer, or licensed dealer unless the transferee is provided with a locking device for that firearm and the firearm is accompanied by a warning, in conspicuous and legible type in capital letters printed on a separate sheet of paper included within the packaging enclosing the firearm, that firearms should be locked and kept away from children and that there may be civil and criminal liability for failing to do so. The bill provides exceptions for law-enforcement and governmental agencies.
[H.B. 267](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XtrhacWbEvslC4i31N2mPSaX_DzLI-eVxZSgJvOlIe_hoLjXzvG0VyBX1q3xnjEqAQLizMK8x4AO3HbSt-MoF5sz2r_0lI1cKGbTRuIa-BppylfwDcGVntVDx8nKycO6c-pc8UFE93K3tytsu3BXtNlaF1T1jYSmGC23gSLGeTRvofEBaYDgfaqpE4wqJ5w1qLa9BYEGNrM=&c=G5xXfAZVXf9oeNikmRRglTLfw9p3j92B_tf5Y1r1n5umF3VW0edxqg==&ch=lTJ_3T64CE5cOxh9deXS0Qg-LT6tuZNd72lkecb5DR2c5mL_4ZG1pA==) Patron: Watts Assault or assault and battery against a law-enforcement officer; arrest and prosecution of individual experiencing a mental health emergency. Provides that it is an affirmative defense to prosecution of an individual for assault or assault and battery against a law-enforcement officer or a correctional officer, both defined in the bill, if at the time of the assault or assault and battery (i) the law-enforcement officer or correctional officer was responding to a request for service; (ii) (a) the individual had (1) a mental illness or (2) a neurocognitive disorder, including dementia, or a neurodevelopmental disability, including a developmental disability or intellectual disability, such as autism spectrum disorder, as defined in the most recent edition of the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders of the American Psychiatric Association or (b) the individual met the criteria for the issuance of an emergency custody order; and (iii) the assault or assault and battery was caused by or had a direct and substantial relationship to the person's illness, disorder, or disability. The bill also provides that such affirmative defense shall not be construed to allow an affirmative defense for voluntary intoxication.
[H.B. 351](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XtrhacWbEvslC4i31N2mPSaX_DzLI-eVxZSgJvOlIe_hoLjXzvG0VxVRrpVWDcQUpuJIsNU8nfiBGY257R3tPD-ut4mIN1U0m1PNMJJIKKLK_H06NxlMdSJ44GfQmzTK8d4-L9jIzK5hspGO0KEqA11zrDfwBe4NRLTO4LxZgn2TFVLo7M3APWmjjkqQ8V1Lg9lJB4TqfrM=&c=G5xXfAZVXf9oeNikmRRglTLfw9p3j92B_tf5Y1r1n5umF3VW0edxqg==&ch=lTJ_3T64CE5cOxh9deXS0Qg-LT6tuZNd72lkecb5DR2c5mL_4ZG1pA==) Patron: Clark Firearm locking device required for purchase of a firearm; households where minor resides; penalty. Requires any person who purchases a firearm to either (i) purchase a locking device for such firearm if such person resides in the same household as a minor or (ii) complete a certification statement on a form provided by the Department of State Police, under penalty of perjury, certifying that he does not reside in the same household as a minor, with exceptions enumerated in the bill. Accordingly, the bill provides that it is unlawful for any licensed manufacturer, licensed importer, or licensed dealer to sell, deliver, or transfer any firearm to any person, other than a licensed manufacturer, licensed importer, or licensed dealer, unless the transferee (a) purchases a locking device for such firearm if such person resides in the same household as a minor or (b) completes a certification statement on a form provided by the Department of State Police, under penalty of perjury, certifying that he does not reside in the same household as a minor. A violation of either provision is a Class 1 misdemeanor.
[H.B. 455](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XtrhacWbEvslC4i31N2mPSaX_DzLI-eVxZSgJvOlIe_hoLjXzvG0VyBX1q3xnjEqJf1i4ehY9FF7Ug9kUT-6YpYTo18Ziv3m-DHu4MufdKpXBzQfQ7t08OiwgdXtikQysyRnj2OkesWc8dxv_mos6cMhKBORr0hPkqGqIS39NDPVANKt-XLQwjzLJ5TEvXkVveJmeEisSZQ=&c=G5xXfAZVXf9oeNikmRRglTLfw9p3j92B_tf5Y1r1n5umF3VW0edxqg==&ch=lTJ_3T64CE5cOxh9deXS0Qg-LT6tuZNd72lkecb5DR2c5mL_4ZG1pA==) Patron: Callsen Possession of an item containing less than one gram of a controlled substance; penalty. Creates a Class 1 misdemeanor for the offense of possession of an item containing less than one gram of a controlled substance. The bill provides that upon motion of the attorney for the Commonwealth, a charge for possession of a controlled substance classified in Schedule I or II of the Drug Control Act shall be reduced to unlawful possession of an item containing less than one gram of a controlled substance. Currently, possession of any amount of such controlled substance is a Class 5 felony. This bill is a recommendation of the Virginia Criminal Justice Conference.
[H.B. 776](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XtrhacWbEvslC4i31N2mPSaX_DzLI-eVxZSgJvOlIe_hoLjXzvG0V_-pi6ZjLfafaCIfconR9NbxzkvN-2ioFikhOcBNGa86Lk8FirH5uVpe9V_wSPzQp5yPZw4dxa3Y0fSJPqsFdJDAVDSioYydBrxW1NlD35dyht6BSRZdwGqdqczDK8tSpSgFPOV5E_-N97OfC9Xw34o=&c=G5xXfAZVXf9oeNikmRRglTLfw9p3j92B_tf5Y1r1n5umF3VW0edxqg==&ch=lTJ_3T64CE5cOxh9deXS0Qg-LT6tuZNd72lkecb5DR2c5mL_4ZG1pA==) Patron: Herring Minimum qualifications for law-enforcement officers; citizenship; waiver. Allows individuals who are lawfully admitted for permanent residence who have resided in the United States for no less than 60 months and who are both eligible for and have applied for United States citizenship to qualify for the positions of chief of police and all police officers of any locality, all deputy sheriffs and jail officers in the Commonwealth, and all law-enforcement officers. The bill allows any agency or department employing law-enforcement officers to hire, recruit, or refer an individual who is a citizen of the United States over another individual who meets such qualifications if such individuals are equally qualified. Current law only allows citizens of the United States to qualify for the named positions; the citizenship requirement can only be waived for good cause upon request of a sheriff or chief of police or the director or chief executive of any agency or department employing law-enforcement officers to the Department of Criminal Justice Services.
[H.B. 962](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XtrhacWbEvslC4i31N2mPSaX_DzLI-eVxZSgJvOlIe_hoLjXzvG0VyBX1q3xnjEqiJB7LyL-66FFLdmePyXBycpnv5r2t06OAP_iXUPPO0AKXXbpokzpylRl9bD5RIcYX9xF4ab-VROy3CozopxUv4nM8_ooG2qdqBinlQU8JFrvpi8FyXMDWWegZqDG5o4oMYujS9HwLKo=&c=G5xXfAZVXf9oeNikmRRglTLfw9p3j92B_tf5Y1r1n5umF3VW0edxqg==&ch=lTJ_3T64CE5cOxh9deXS0Qg-LT6tuZNd72lkecb5DR2c5mL_4ZG1pA==) Patron: Lopez Noncitizens of the United States; terminology. Removes the term "alien" as it pertains to persons who are not citizens or nationals of the United States and replaces it with synonymous language, as appropriate, throughout the Code of Virginia.
[H.B. 1539](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XtrhacWbEvslC4i31N2mPSaX_DzLI-eVxZSgJvOlIe_hoLjXzvG0V98IP-WQkWxFhs7xoW3N7ZYNmumSF9yF3ZerkgFeX5_FLJ_3gByc6vBX6Y8DJw28hb5mJhfWZ1lWZap6CVxE4iT6Avc8ppJTjYxPHyLEHLm7a86uP-SxczIUIwTrslQumuru7LMusIonuBb17YjMszQ=&c=G5xXfAZVXf9oeNikmRRglTLfw9p3j92B_tf5Y1r1n5umF3VW0edxqg==&ch=lTJ_3T64CE5cOxh9deXS0Qg-LT6tuZNd72lkecb5DR2c5mL_4ZG1pA==) Patron: Simon Abortion or other reproductive health care services; prohibitions on extradition for certain crimes; prohibited practices under Virginia Consumer Protection Act. Provides that no demand for extradition of a person charged with a criminal violation of the law of another state shall be recognized by the Governor if such alleged violation involves the receipt of or assistance with reproductive health care services, defined in the bill, within the Commonwealth unless the alleged criminal violation would also constitute a criminal offense under the laws of the Commonwealth. The bill also provides that such limit on extradition shall not apply when the person who is subject to such demand for extradition by another state was physically present in the demanding state at the time of the commission of the alleged offense and thereafter fled from such state. The bill adds obtaining, disclosing, selling, or disseminating certain enumerated personal reproductive or sexual health information without the consent of the consumer as a prohibited practice under the Virginia Consumer Protection Act. This bill incorporates HB 1493.
