HB 1405 Cousins Prisoners; Department of Corrections- and jailer-issued identification. | | == | == Patron: Helmer Hate crimes and discrimination; ethnic animosity; penalties. Provides that it is the policy of the Commonwealth to safeguard all individuals within the Commonwealth from unlawful discrimination in employment and in places of public accommodation because of such individual's ethnic origin and prohibits such discrimination. The bill also adds victims who are intentionally selected because of their ethnic origin to the categories of victims whose intentional selection for a hate crime involving assault, assault and battery, or trespass for the purpose of damaging another's property results in a higher criminal penalty for the offense. The bill also provides that no provider or user of an interactive computer service on the Internet shall be liable for any action voluntarily taken by it in good faith to restrict access to material that the provider or user considers to be intended to incite hatred on the basis of ethnic origin. == Patron: Campbell Animal Cruelty Conviction List established. Requires the Superintendent of State Police to establish no later than January 1, 2027, and to maintain the Animal Cruelty Conviction List and to make the List available to the public on the website of the Department of State Police. The bill specifies that the List include the names of persons convicted of certain felony animal cruelty offenses on or after July 1, 2024. The bill requires persons convicted of any such offense to pay a fee of $50 per conviction to fund the maintenance of the List. The bill also requires the Department to remove a person's name and information from the List 15 years after its listing if he has no additional felony conviction of any such offense. == Patron: Simon Manufacture, import, sale, transfer, or possession of plastic firearms and unfinished frames or receivers and unserialized firearms prohibited; penalties. Creates a Class 5 felony for any person who knowingly manufactures or assembles, imports, purchases, sells, transfers, or possesses any firearm that, after removal of all parts other than a major component, as defined in the bill, is not detectable as a firearm when subjected to inspection by the types of detection devices, including X-ray machines, commonly used at airports, government buildings, schools, correctional facilities, and other locations for security screening. The bill updates language regarding the types of detection devices that are used at such locations for detecting plastic firearms. Under current law, it is unlawful to manufacture, import, sell, transfer, or possess any plastic firearm and a violation is punishable as a Class 5 felony. The bill also creates a Class 1 misdemeanor, which is punishable as a Class 4 felony for a second or subsequent offense, making it unlawful for any person to knowingly import, purchase, sell, offer for sale, or transfer ownership of any completed or unfinished frame or receiver, unless the completed or unfinished frame or receiver (i) is deemed to be a firearm pursuant to federal law and (ii) is imprinted with a valid serial number. The bill creates a Class 1 misdemeanor, which is punishable as a Class 4 felony for a second or subsequent offense, making it unlawful for any person to knowingly possess a firearm that it not imprinted with a valid serial number, or to manufacture or assemble, cause to be manufactured or assembled, import, purchase, sell, offer for sale, or transfer ownership of any firearm that is not imprinted with a valid serial number. The portions of the bill prohibiting unfinished frames or receivers and unserialized firearms have a delayed effective date of January 1, 2025. == Patron: Simon Storage of firearms in a residence where a minor or person prohibited from possessing a firearm is present; penalty. Requires any person who possesses a firearm in a residence where such person knows that a minor under 18 years of age or a person who is prohibited by law from possessing a firearm is present to store such firearm and the ammunition for such firearm in a locked container, compartment, or cabinet that is inaccessible to such minor or prohibited person. The bill provides that a violation is a Class 4 misdemeanor. The bill exempts (i) any person in lawful possession of a firearm who carries such firearm on or about his person and (ii) the storage of antique firearms and provides that the lawful authorization of a minor to access a firearm is not a violation of the bill's provisions. The bill also requires firearm dealers to post a notice stating such firearm storage requirements and the penalty for improperly storing such firearms. == Patron: Callsen Carrying a firearm or explosive material within Capitol Square or building owned or leased by the Commonwealth; exemptions; public institutions of higher education; penalty. Limits the exemption from the prohibition on the carrying of any firearm or explosive material within any building owned or leased by the Commonwealth or agency thereof or any office where employees of the Commonwealth or any agency thereof are regularly present for the purpose of performing their official duties that currently applies to any property owned or operated by a public institution of higher education to instead apply to any individual within a building owned or operated by a public institution of higher education who possesses a weapon as part of such public institution of higher education's curriculum or activities or as part of any organization authorized by such public institution of higher education to conduct its programs or activities within such building, as such uses are approved through the law-enforcement or public safety unit of such institution. == Patron: Hernandez Weapons; possession or transportation; facility that provides mental health services or developmental services; penalty. Makes it a Class 1 misdemeanor for any person to knowingly possess in or transport into the building of any hospital that provides mental health services or developmental services in the Commonwealth, including an emergency department or other facility rendering emergency medical care, any (i) firearm or other weapon designed or intended to propel a missile or projectile of any kind; (ii) knife, except a pocket knife having a folding metal blade of less than three inches; or (iii) other dangerous weapon, including explosives and stun weapons. The bill also provides that notice of such prohibitions shall be posted conspicuously at the public entrance of any hospital and no person shall be convicted of the offense if such notice is not posted, unless such person had actual notice of the prohibitions. The bill provides that any such firearm, knife, explosive, or weapon shall be subject to seizure by a law-enforcement officer and forfeited to the Commonwealth and specifies exceptions to the prohibition. == Patron: Sickles Assault firearms; purchase; age requirement; penalty. Provides that in order to purchase an assault firearm a person must be 21 years of age or older. The bill also expands the definition of "assault firearm" as the term applies to criminal history record information checks. == Patron: Hayes Purchase of firearms; waiting period; penalty. Provides that no person shall sell a firearm unless at least five days have elapsed from the time the prospective purchaser completes the written consent form to have a licensed dealer obtain criminal history record information, with exceptions enumerated in relevant law. == Patron: Lopez Limited-duration licenses and driver privilege cards and permits; expiration. Extends the validity of limited-duration licenses, driver privilege cards and permits, and identification privilege cards, other than REAL ID credentials and commercial driver's licenses and permits, to a period of time consistent with the validity of driver's licenses, which, under current law, is a period not to exceed eight years or, for a person age 75 or older, a period not to exceed five years, and permits and special identification cards. The bill directs the Department of Motor Vehicles to implement the extended validity periods for such documents upon reissuance. | | == House Bills on Third Reading - Regular Calendar ... == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == | | == | vehicle charging facilities; infrastructure necessary to support installation. Patron: McClure Commission on Electric Utility Regulation; evaluation of infrastructure necessary for electric vehicle charging facilities. Directs the Commission on Electric Utility Regulation (the Commission) to evaluate the design and deployment of the electrical distribution infrastructure necessary to support the installation of electric vehicle charging facilities in new developments consisting of single-family and multifamily residential units. The bill requires the Commission to engage representatives from the residential and commercial development industries, private sector utility consultants, and other stakeholders. == Zoning for Housing Production Pilot Program; created, affordable dwelling unit policy incentives. Patron: Carr Housing; Zoning for Housing Production Fund created; affordable dwelling unit policy incentives; report. Creates the Zoning for Housing Production Program to be administered by the Department of Housing and Community Development (the Department). To be eligible for a grant from the Program, a locality is required to make a change to its zoning policies to allow for by-right development that is expected to further the goal of creating and maintaining mixed-income communities, affordable housing, and moderately priced housing, as those terms are defined in the bill. The Department of Housing and Community Development is required to establish certain guidelines and to notify the localities of the existence and purpose of the Program no later than September 1, 2024. The bill has an expiration date of July 1, 2027. == Virginia Consumer Protection Act; prohibited practices, selling ignition interlock system. Patron: Williams Virginia Consumer Protection Act; prohibited practices; ignition interlock system. Provides that selling or offering for sale any ignition interlock system without a conspicuous statement that such advertisement is unrelated to any criminal proceeding or government agency is an unlawful consumer transaction in violation of the Virginia Consumer Protection Act. The provisions of the bill do not become effective unless reenacted by the 2025 Session of the General Assembly. == State agencies and their appointing authorities; diversity, equity, and inclusion strategic plans. Patron: Askew Duties of agencies and their appointing authorities; diversity, equity, and inclusion strategic plans. Requires each state agency to submit its annual report assessing the impact of its diversity, equity, and inclusion strategic plans on the populations served by the agency and on the agency's workforce budget to the General Assembly, in addition to the Governor, by July 1 of each year. | | == | == Patron: Simon Common-law crime of suicide. Abolishes the common-law crime of suicide. Suicide is currently a common-law crime in Virginia, although there is no statutorily prescribed punishment. == Patron: McClure Firearm locking device required for sale or transfer of firearm; warning against accessibility to children; penalty. Makes it a Class 3 misdemeanor for any licensed manufacturer, licensed importer, or licensed dealer to sell, deliver, or transfer any firearm to any person other than a licensed manufacturer, licensed importer, or licensed dealer unless the transferee is provided with a locking device for that firearm and the firearm is accompanied by a warning, in conspicuous and legible type in capital letters printed on a separate sheet of paper included within the packaging enclosing the firearm, that firearms should be locked and kept away from children and that there may be civil and criminal liability for failing to do so. The bill provides exceptions for law-enforcement and governmental agencies. == Patron: Watts Assault or assault and battery against a law-enforcement officer; arrest and prosecution of individual experiencing a mental health emergency. Provides that it is an affirmative defense to prosecution of an individual for assault or assault and battery against a law-enforcement officer or a correctional officer, both defined in the bill, if at the time of the assault or assault and battery (i) the law-enforcement officer or correctional officer was responding to a request for service; (ii) (a) the individual had (1) a mental illness or (2) a neurocognitive disorder, including dementia, or a neurodevelopmental disability, including a developmental disability or intellectual disability, such as autism spectrum disorder, as defined in the most recent edition of the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders of the American Psychiatric Association or (b) the individual met the criteria for the issuance of an emergency custody order; and (iii) the assault or assault and battery was caused by or had a direct and substantial relationship to the person's illness, disorder, or disability. The bill also provides that such affirmative defense shall not be construed to allow an affirmative defense for voluntary intoxication. == Patron: Clark Firearm locking device required for purchase of a firearm; households where minor resides; penalty. Requires any person who purchases a firearm to either (i) purchase a locking device for such firearm if such person resides in the same household as a minor or (ii) complete a certification statement on a form provided by the Department of State Police, under penalty of perjury, certifying that he does not reside in the same household as a minor, with exceptions enumerated in the bill. Accordingly, the bill provides that it is unlawful for any licensed manufacturer, licensed importer, or licensed dealer to sell, deliver, or transfer any firearm to any person, other than a licensed manufacturer, licensed importer, or licensed dealer, unless the transferee (a) purchases a locking device for such firearm if such person resides in the same household as a minor or (b) completes a certification statement on a form provided by the Department of State Police, under penalty of perjury, certifying that he does not reside in the same household as a minor. A violation of either provision is a Class 1 misdemeanor. == Patron: Callsen Possession of an item containing less than one gram of a controlled substance; penalty. Creates a Class 1 misdemeanor for the offense of possession of an item containing less than one gram of a controlled substance. The bill provides that upon motion of the attorney for the Commonwealth, a charge for possession of a controlled substance classified in Schedule I or II of the Drug Control Act shall be reduced to unlawful possession of an item containing less than one gram of a controlled substance. Currently, possession of any amount of such controlled substance is a Class 5 felony. This bill is a recommendation of the Virginia Criminal Justice Conference. == Patron: Herring Minimum qualifications for law-enforcement officers; citizenship; waiver. Allows individuals who are lawfully admitted for permanent residence who have resided in the United States for no less than 60 months and who are both eligible for and have applied for United States citizenship to qualify for the positions of chief of police and all police officers of any locality, all deputy sheriffs and jail officers in the Commonwealth, and all law-enforcement officers. The bill allows any agency or department employing law-enforcement officers to hire, recruit, or refer an individual who is a citizen of the United States over another individual who meets such qualifications if such individuals are equally qualified. Current law only allows citizens of the United States to qualify for the named positions; the citizenship requirement can only be waived for good cause upon request of a sheriff or chief of police or the director or chief executive of any agency or department employing law-enforcement officers to the Department of Criminal Justice Services. == Patron: Lopez Noncitizens of the United States; terminology. Removes the term "alien" as it pertains to persons who are not citizens or nationals of the United States and replaces it with synonymous language, as appropriate, throughout the Code of Virginia. == Patron: Simon Abortion or other reproductive health care services; prohibitions on extradition for certain crimes; prohibited practices under Virginia Consumer Protection Act. Provides that no demand for extradition of a person charged with a criminal violation of the law of another state shall be recognized by the Governor if such alleged violation involves the receipt of or assistance with reproductive health care services, defined in the bill, within the Commonwealth unless the alleged criminal violation would also constitute a criminal offense under the laws of the Commonwealth. The bill also provides that such limit on extradition shall not apply when the person who is subject to such demand for extradition by another state was physically present in the demanding state at the time of the commission of the alleged offense and thereafter fled from such state. The bill adds obtaining, disclosing, selling, or disseminating certain enumerated personal reproductive or sexual health information without the consent of the consumer as a prohibited practice under the Virginia Consumer Protection Act. [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/79863276/457708171/1237601583?refcode=WTEFEN56_20240227_TrumpShortlist_ND&sourceid=1052959&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNDNkYzY0Zi1iM2Q1LWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ziTasvAaus2gLjJ2CoOqyvf0EIn9w8yfTvxG89OpFGc=) Last week, Donald Trump confirmed that he's got a shortlist of potential running mates — and that **Ron DeSantis** , **Vivek Ramaswamy** , and **Kristi Noem** are all on that list.

Here's what we know for sure, Peter: Trump's VP pick will be an anti-choice, anti-democratic extremist _no matter whom_ he chooses.

Here at EMILYs List, we've got our own pick for VP. # FROM THE DESK OF MONICA CROWLEY
---
| | Dear Reader,We’re headed deep into election season and the future of our country is at stake.

One of the things that deeply concerns me is the state of our press.

Without reliable newspapers fairly calling balls and strikes, anything can happen.

**It’s for this reason that the recent revival of the famed New York Sun is so vital.**

| | It is a newspaper that has practiced _real_ American journalism since it first hit the streets of New York in 1833.

The Sun has only one agenda: To serve the American people and to uphold our Constitution.

There’s never been a moment where I’m more fearful for the future of both. I am grateful to know we have the Sun in our corner.

In the other corner, though, stands the full weight of the many newspapers that have forgotten who they serve and what our country stands for — and in some cases, are actively working against those cherished things.

body:
Derek — did you
see Tony’s message? This month he made historic progress by signing fair
legislative maps for the state of Wisconsin. However, these incredible
efforts are threatened by Donald Trump’s plans to become a dictator and
end fair elections. With polls deadlocked, we need your help.

[ https://go.tonyevers.com/go/2231?amount=25&refcode=EM_NBI_FR_Feb2024_MMFR_0_3MO_TonyEvers_NA_NA_1.5&t=1001&akid=6621%2E1827488%2EkrmUNj ]Can we count on you to chip in here before our end of month deadline to
help close our $23,492 budget gap?

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Begin Forwarded Message

Derek,

I have big news — this month, I signed fair legislative maps for the state
of Wisconsin, undoing more than a decade of the worst gerrymandering in
the United States. This is a victory for the people of Wisconsin, who’ve
been demanding more and deserve better from their elected officials.

[ https://go.tonyevers.com/go/2231?amount=25&refcode=EM_NBI_FR_Feb2024_MMFR_0_3MO_TonyEvers_NA_NA_1.5&t=1002&akid=6621%2E1827488%2EkrmUNj ]While this is a huge victory, national polls are deadlocked here in
Wisconsin and we won’t enjoy the benefits of fair legislative elections if
Donald Trump wins and is able to enact his plan to roll back our progress
and take away basic rights on day one. That’s why I’m asking you to click
here and pitch in to help us close our $29,493 budget gap before
Wednesday’s end-of-month deadline.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation
will process immediately.

[ https://go.tonyevers.com/go/2232?amount=10&refcode=EM_NBI_FR_Feb2024_MMFR_0_3MO_TonyEvers_NA_NA_1.5&t=1003&akid=6621%2E1827488%2EkrmUNj ]Donate $10 Now

[ https://go.tonyevers.com/go/2232?amount=100&refcode=EM_NBI_FR_Feb2024_MMFR_0_3MO_TonyEvers_NA_NA_1.5&t=1006&akid=6621%2E1827488%2EkrmUNj ]Donate $100 Now

[ https://go.tonyevers.com/go/2214?amount=500&refcode=EM_NBI_FR_Feb2024_MMFR_0_3MO_TonyEvers_NA_NA_1.5&t=1007&akid=6621%2E1827488%2EkrmUNj ]Donate $500 Now

[ https://go.tonyevers.com/go/2231?amount=10&refcode=EM_NBI_FR_Feb2024_MMFR_0_3MO_TonyEvers_NA_NA_1.5&t=1008&akid=6621%2E1827488%2EkrmUNj ]Another Amount

Our new legislative maps are huge for three reasons:

First: These maps are fair and drawn to make sure Wisconsinites enjoy the
representation they deserve.

Second: These maps are responsive. Every vote matters — races will be more
competitive and contested, ensuring lawmakers listen to the needs of their
constituents.

Finally: These maps reflect the will of the people. Depending on voters’
preferences, the people can elect Republican or Democratic majorities.
Wisconsinites decide who they want electing them in public office, just as
elections should work.

I’ve always believed that the people should get to choose their elected
officials, and not the other way.

But the fight is not over,
Derek. We need to ensure that
progress in favor of democracy like this is protected, and that starts
with building up our strength to defeat MAGA Republicans in November.

[ https://go.tonyevers.com/go/2231?amount=25&refcode=EM_NBI_FR_Feb2024_MMFR_0_3MO_TonyEvers_NA_NA_1.5&t=1009&akid=6621%2E1827488%2EkrmUNj ]Please donate what you can to help us reach our end of month
fundraising goal.

Onward,

Tony

body:
Will you add your name today to call on the Supreme Court to keep the federal ban on bump stocks in place?
#

Team -
Tomorrow, the Supreme Court will hear a challenge to the federal ban on bump stocks. These are devices that convert semi-automatic firearms into fully automatic firearms.
[**Will you please add your name to call on the Supreme Court to keep the federal ban on bump stocks in place?**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_bumpstocks_pet_feb24/?source=em240227-2-15&refcode2=7701.3935704.9pvf6V&akid=7701%2E3935704%2E9pvf6V)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_bumpstocks_pet_feb24/?source=em240227-2-15&refcode2=7701.3935704.9pvf6V&akid=7701%2E3935704%2E9pvf6V)**
Bump stocks pose a grave risk to public safety. They circumvent the federal ban on automatic weapons and were used in the 2017 Las Vegas shooting, which left 60 people dead and more than 800 people injured.
Classifying bump stocks as machine guns is both commonsense and constitutional. There’s good reason why fully automatic rifles are heavily regulated by the federal government. The Supreme Court should use this same reasoning to keep the ban on bump stocks intact.
[**This is important. Please add your name today to join us in calling on the Supreme Court to keep the federal ban on bump stocks in place.**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_bumpstocks_pet_feb24/?source=em240227-2-15&refcode2=7701.3935704.9pvf6V&akid=7701%2E3935704%2E9pvf6V)

Thanks for speaking up. Lives are on the line.
\- The team at GIFFORDS

subject: It's our fight, not theirs
body:
| | | [ ](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzs2u921EReiR88ARqrt5HWpbBPunnEofCMh9dr_AFzKQcn9111POo4ow65tpCU15LRHWRvsfIjn0rabZBMaIjLV&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=022724_writing_off_wv&n=1&v=24)
---
Dear Friend, I hope this message finds you in a fighting spirit because that's precisely what we need right now. I'm not going to mince words: I'm mad as hell. The talking heads and political elite have written off West Virginia, saying it's a lost cause for Democrats. But I'm here to call their bluff. Remember Bernie Sanders? In the 2016 primaries, he showed us something incredible - when a candidate truly stands up for the working folks, West Virginia listens. Bernie's message resonated here because he spoke about the real struggles we face every day. It wasn't about left or right; it was about right and wrong. That's the fight I'm bringing to this Senate race. I'm not your polished, suit-wearing politician. **I come from the same hardworking background as you. I've faced the same struggles, and I'm fed up with being ignored by those who claim to represent us. It's time for one of our own to stand up and fight back.**
---
[ ](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzs2u921EReiR88ARqrt5HWpbBPunnEofCMh9dr_AFzKQcn9111POo4ow65tpCU15LRHWRvsfIjn0rabZBMaIjLV&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=022724_writing_off_wv&n=2&v=24)

---
They say we can't win. That West Virginia has gone red for good. But I say they're dead wrong. They don't know the heart of our people. They've never set foot in West Virginia. They don't understand that when someone truly has our back, we show up. We make our voices heard. This isn't just about winning a Senate seat. It's about taking a stand for our dignity, for our jobs, and for our families. It's about showing the country that West Virginia won't be pigeonholed or written off. I'm ready to fight this battle but can't do it alone. I need you with me. **[Every dollar you can spare, every hour you can volunteer, brings us closer to proving them all wrong. Let's show them what happens when you underestimate the heart and determination of West Virginians.](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzs2u921EReiR88ARqrt5HWpbBPunnEofCMh9dr_AFzKQcn9111POo4ow65tpCU15LRHWRvsfIjn0rabZBMaIjLV&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=022724_writing_off_wv&n=4&v=24)** Together, we can do this. **[Let's fight the good fight and win this seat, not for the pundits, not for the party, but for us - the hardworking people of West Virginia.](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzs2u921EReiR88ARqrt5HWpbBPunnEofCMh9dr_AFzKQcn9111POo4ow65tpCU15LRHWRvsfIjn0rabZBMaIjLV&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=022724_writing_off_wv&n=5&v=24)** In solidarity, Zach Shrewsbury (D-WV) Candidate, U.S. Senate

Our hearts sank

Farewell, Ted Cruz.

clean_body: Will you help defeat this liberal lineup? | | | | | | Patriot, That’s the day of the California primary. The top two go head-to-head in November. I can think of only one thing worse than a General Election ballot that forces Californians to “choose” between three dyed-in-the-wool leftists like Schiff, Porter, or Lee... ...and that’s being forced to endure six years of Schiff, Porter, or Lee in the U.S. Senate. I need your help to go “three up...three down” against this lineup of liberal career politicians. That’s a bit of baseball vernacular. No surprise, right? It means you record three outs against the first three batters in an inning. Then, it’s your team’s turn to go on offense. Well, that’s very much the case in this election... ...you and I need to strike out this lineup of liberals so we can get to work saving our country. Liberals straight out of Congress where all three have spent a combined 51 years – most recently acting as rubberstamps for the Biden agenda that has done so much harm to our state and our nation. Which is why I’m reaching out to you today. Think about the crumbling quality of life in my once-great state of California. Think about the daily reality of: • Fear of walking down the street, taking their kids to school, or running a small business because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. • The exploding cost of living (gas, food, shelter) which for the first time in our history is causing more people to leave California. • Failing public schools and plummeting test scores. The numbers don’t lie... prolonged school closings not only robbed our kids of learning but of social interaction. If you believe, as I do, that voters deserve better than a “false choice” between Schiff, Porter, and Lee on November 5, 2024, Winning this election requires a one-two punch: 1\. Finish in the top two on March 5th (very doable as the Democrat vote will be split three ways). 2\. An eight-month grassroots and TV, radio, and online campaign “connecting the dots” between the policies pushed by Schiff/Porter/Lee and the brutal reality facing Californians every day. In my playing days, I would never be out-worked or out-hustled. That’s my approach to this campaign. Door-knocks, phone-calls, rallies, townhalls, you name it. With you on our side, I’m confident we can not only give voters a real choice, but someone who remembers how great California was and knows how great it can be again. | | With deepest appreciation, Steve Garvey Republican for United States Senate | | | | | | | MY VISION My campaign is focused on quality-of-life issues, public safety, and education. body:
Washington state, like many states, has a child care crisis. Too many families are being forced to choose between working or staying home because childcare is either not available or affordable.

| Peter,

**Expanding access to affordable, high-quality childcare is one of my top priorities, and I want to tell you why and what I’ve done to address our childcare crisis.**

Growing up in a single-parent working-class household, I saw the struggle for affordable childcare firsthand. After school and on weekends, my dad would bring my sister and I to city hall and the fire station where he worked because it was difficult to find and afford child care. Later, as a mother of three small boys, my dad was diagnosed with early-onset dementia. I cared for him in our home as I struggled to find affordable childcare and adult care.

Washington state, like many states, has a childcare crisis. Too many families are being forced to choose between working or staying home because childcare is either not available or affordable. This is not just an economic crisis but a social crisis. Research tells us that a child’s early years are paramount and can set the stage for the rest of their lives. Tackling the high cost of childcare is one of the best investments we can make in America’s future - setting kids up for success and helping their parents stay in the workforce and provide better opportunities for their families.

As Commissioner of Public Lands, I manage millions of acres of land that generate critical funding for K-12 education. Recognizing our childcare crisis and that a child’s education starts long before kindergarten, this year, I championed a bill that would provide dedicated funding to meet our childcare crisis while also protecting our environment. In Congress, I am committed to championing affordable childcare and lifting up working families and childcare workers. But I need your support to make this vision a reality.

clean_body: Washington state, like many states, has a child care crisis. Too many families are being forced to choose between working or staying home because childcare is either not available or affordable. | = | Peter, Expanding access to affordable, high-quality childcare is one of my top priorities, and I want to tell you why and what I’ve done to address our childcare crisis. Growing up in a single-parent working-class household, I saw the struggle for affordable childcare firsthand. After school and on weekends, my dad would bring my sister and I to city hall and the fire station where he worked because it was difficult to find and afford child care. Later, as a mother of three small boys, my dad was diagnosed with early-onset dementia. I cared for him in our home as I struggled to find affordable childcare and adult care. Washington state, like many states, has a childcare crisis. Too many families are being forced to choose between working or staying home because childcare is either not available or affordable. This is not just an economic crisis but a social crisis. Research tells us that a child’s early years are paramount and can set the stage for the rest of their lives. Tackling the high cost of childcare is one of the best investments we can make in America’s future - setting kids up for success and helping their parents stay in the workforce and provide better opportunities for their families. As Commissioner of Public Lands, I manage millions of acres of land that generate critical funding for K-12 education. Recognizing our childcare crisis and that a child’s education starts long before kindergarten, this year, I championed a bill that would provide dedicated funding to meet our childcare crisis while also protecting our environment. In Congress, I am committed to championing affordable childcare and lifting up working families and childcare workers. | | Peter, as I write this, early voting has officially begun in Ohio's primary election. **The fate of the Senate hangs in the balance, and I need you by my side more than ever. Let me explain.**

No matter which GOP opponent wins this primary, we're facing an uphill battle to defend Ohio's must-win seat. Polls show us _statistically tied,_ and Mitch McConnell has personally named me a top target for defeat. **Now, his dark-money super PACs just made their largest ad reservation in a single state _ever_ to attack me on the airwaves and drown out our pro-worker message.**

Experts say Ohio could decide Senate control, and I simply can't fight back against these attacks without your support, Peter. With voters casting their primary ballots right now, we're running out of time to raise the resources we need to start the general election off strong.

**That's why we set a goal to raise $100,000 in the next 48 hours so we can fuel our voter outreach efforts, TV ads, and more. And I'm personally counting on you to help me get there.**

**The stakes couldn't be higher, so I'm asking:** [**_Will you split $25 or more between my campaign and the GA Dems to help us reach the voters we need to win in Ohio and keep the Senate blue?_**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79868576/457725555/-843865763?refcode=20240227.2_ShB_2AQ&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYTJiZmJkYy1iZmQ1LWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ez7WNOwiRDVgx2y3jBxSv9U01d6gUWsvefe1Y-STcfo=)

Thanks for standing with me in this fight.

-Sherrod

name: Hill Harper (personal)
subject: I don’t expect my supporters to cut $20 million checks to my campaign
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY HILL HARPER FOR MICHIGAN
body:
But I do hope you’ll chip in to help us stay on track.
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1018%2E62735%2EDwNIZ5)
Hey Peter, it’s Hill --
I want to thank you so much for supporting our movement to build a better Michigan. Ever since we filed to get on the ballot earlier this month, the energy we’ve felt around the campaign has never been higher. It’s all thanks to everyday folks chipping in here and there to fuel our work, and it means the world.
Now, I don’t expect my supporters to cut $20 million checks to our campaign -- and I was proud to turn down that special interest money last year because _I can’t be bought._ But the reality is this: We have to work even harder to spread our message, build grassroots momentum, and defy the odds against the D.C. establishment.
**Peter, this only works if we come together as a community and fight for the progressive future Michiganders deserve.[Please read my email below, then, chip in just $5 to help hit my campaign’s February fundraising goal before Thursday’s deadline. Every grassroots dollar is critical, so I’m counting on you!](https://act.hillharper.com/go/457?t=3&akid=1018%2E62735%2EDwNIZ5)**
_\- HH_

**Begin forwarded message:**
\---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Hill Harper [(info@e.hillharper.com)](https://act.hillharper.com/go/458?t=4&akid=1018%2E62735%2EDwNIZ5)
Date: February 23, 2024
Subject: lessons from grandpa’s farm

> Peter —
> Something I learned on my grandfather’s farm growing up is that when you plant seeds in good soil, you get a _much_ better yield in return. Sure, I don’t do as much farming these days, but the lesson — the value of starting on a good, strong foundation in everything I do — has stuck with me over the years.
> It’s why I’m raising my son Pierce right here in Michigan, in a community of folks who are kind, hardworking, and willing to fight for their future.
> It’s why I launched a grassroots Senate campaign built of, by, and for working Michiganders — one that doesn’t take a _dime_ from corporate PACs.
> It’s why I turned down $20 million from one of AIPAC’s biggest donors, because I know that we can’t fix our broken system if we keep letting the wealthy buy their way to the top.
> **And Peter, it’s why I’m hoping you’ll help propel our people-powered movement to victory with a donation today.**
> **[DONATE »](https://act.hillharper.com/go/458?t=5&akid=1018%2E62735%2EDwNIZ5)**
> By chipping in to our grassroots campaign, you’re planting the seeds of a whole new type of leadership in Washington. I’m not a career politician looking for a fancy new title; **I’m a single dad, union organizer, and small business owner running to be a voice for working families and the communities in Michigan that are too often ignored.**
> With my campaign’s end-of-month fundraising deadline coming up, it would mean the world to receive your support. **[Please, chip in $5 — or any amount that works for you — to help hit our campaign’s critical end-of-month goal and _grow_ our people-powered movement heading into March.](https://act.hillharper.com/go/457?t=8&akid=1018%2E62735%2EDwNIZ5)**
> **[DONATE $5 »](https://act.hillharper.com/go/457?t=9&akid=1018%2E62735%2EDwNIZ5)**
> Thanks so much for chipping in. Together, we’ll plant the seeds of a future we can all be proud of.
> Hill Harper
> Democrat for U.S. Senate
> [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/458?t=10&akid=1018%2E62735%2EDwNIZ5)
* * *

subject: Peter's LCV Membership: Renew Today -- this is urgent
body:
Time sensitive

Peter - our Membership Drive deadline is a few days away, and we're reaching out because we haven't heard from you yet (renew your membership here and your contribution will be tripled https://links.messages.lcv. ).

The truth is your membership matters, and it's particularly critical right now.

Here's the situation: Earlier this month, Senator Joe Manchin backed away from a climate deal after months of negotiations, choosing to side with Big Oil and Republicans. It leaves the deal one vote short -- stalling any real action in Congress for now.

In response, we're redoubling our efforts on pushing the White House to act decisively on climate. The Biden administration has massive amounts of power to curb climate pollution - but that will only happen if the environmental movement makes it happen.

Right now, we're facing a critical test: the Biden administration is weighing a plan to block all new oil and gas drilling leases on public waters.

This could be huge -- and a decision is coming. Right now, we're organizing volunteers from all over the country to flood the administration with letters, pressuring Biden to hold to his promises.

Peter -- it's your membership support that makes victory possible here. But we have to do more. A group of donors has put together a fund to triple match every contribution before Sunday's membership deadline:

Can we count on your support? Claim your membership now - it only takes $5 >> https://links.messages.lcv.

The ban on new oil and gas leases is the first of many huge environmental decisions, Peter. And right now, we're pushing for serious action on so many fronts -- including:
Setting tight standards for power plants and other major emitters of climate pollution
Placing strict limits on air pollution to safeguard all communities Expediting requirements of 100% tailpipe pollution-free new cars by 2035 and trucks by 2040
Protecting communities from hazardous and super-polluting methane Conserving 30% of our public lands and waters by 2030 Declaring a climate emergency - and so much more. The best way you can help win each and every one of these fights right now is to claim your LCV membership - all it takes is a gift of $5 or more. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/k_

Thank you, thank you, thank you, Peter. This is such a critical moment for the environment, and we're so fortunate to have you on the team.

Onward,

Gene Karpinski
President
League of Conservation Voters

subject: Joanna Weiss Is Self Funding Her Campaign With Money Made Representing Corporations For “Smuggling Illegal Immigrants,” “Discrimination,” “Wage Theft"
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/f2e1548f26f6/joanna-weiss-is-self-funding-her-campaign-with-money-made-representing-corporations-for-smuggling-illegal-immigrants-discrimination-wage-theft-1567113?e=7017cc100e)
---
| |
---
| |
**Joanna Weiss Is Self Funding Her Campaign With Money Made Representing Corporations For “Smuggling Illegal Immigrants,” “Discrimination,” “Wage Theft,” and “Union Busting”**
**IRVINE, CA **— Joanna Weiss, already [under scrutiny](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=def4d93aa9&e=7017cc100e) for financing her campaign with proceeds from defending the Diocese of Orange County against sexual abuse allegations by clergy, faces renewed questions over her family’s history of representing corporations in trying to bust labor unions, skirt labor laws, and get away with wage theft and other worker abuse. Weiss has given her campaign close to [$300,000](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=1a2d54b849&e=7017cc100e) dollars from a fortune earned in part from [**“keeping many organizations union free...[and] resisting unwelcome labor union organizing drives.”**](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=91ffc5d9b6&e=7017cc100e)

While her campaign professed support for workers' rights, this contradiction in values and action strikes at the heart of the Weiss candidacy– casting a serious shadow over her integrity and authenticity. The news comes as [MAGA Republican](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=8383858ae0&e=7017cc100e) donors continue to flood Orange County with millions of dollars in dark money supporting Weiss, raising serious questions about who Weiss is and why so much right-wing money is behind her.
_**Several Examples of the Weiss's Legal Work Against Workers, Their Wages, and Their Discrimination Claims**_

**Joanna Weiss Represented Tyson Foods Subsidiaries.
Tyson was Indicted For ‘Conspiracy To Smuggle Illegal Immigrants’ To Work In Its Southern Poultry Plants.**
* In 1999, Joanna Weiss represented H&M Food Systems, a subsidiary of Tyson Foods, in a contract case against the Dairy Farmers of America. Dairy Farmers of America v. H & M Food Systems, et al. [[US District Court, California Central, Case No. 2:98-cv-10689]](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=20650a4f3b&e=7017cc100e)
* Tyson Foods was indicted for [conspiracy to smuggle illegal immigrants](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=3b124af2fd&e=7017cc100e)’ into the United States to work in its poultry plants and accused of [bribery.](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=6da24b1aae&e=7017cc100e)

**Jason Weiss Is A Leading Attorney For One Of The Top Union-Busting Law Firms In America.**
* Jason Weiss, Joanna’s husband, is a [partner in Sheppard Mullin’s labor and employment practice](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=a4f688e3b2&e=7017cc100e), where he earns an estimated $1.2 million a year, which appears to be the sole or primary source of funding for the more than $230,000 that the Weiss family is pouring into this campaign.
* [As the firm itself describes](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=2b1d510738&e=7017cc100e), “Sheppard Mullin offers clients one of the largest and most experienced Labor and Employment practices in the country.” [This practice group was named](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=878b72d183&e=7017cc100e) one of the top 3 management-side labor and employment practice groups in the state of California by _The Recorder_.
* [According to Sheppard Mullin's own website](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=9682eb6eb1&e=7017cc100e), Weiss’s Labor and Employment Practice Group “**regularly assists employers in resisting unwelcome labor union organizing drives** [utilizing] an aggressive, practical and tactically sound approach to organizing drives and labor disputes in a broad variety of industries.” Sheppard Mullin boasts that **“our attorneys have been extremely successful in keeping many organizations union free...”**
* While most anti-union activities happens behind the scenes, Sheppard Mullin’s major role in preventing unionization has played out publicly in several recent high profile cases, including [representing Tesla](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=d2a9bb4863&e=7017cc100e) in that company’s efforts to prevent unionization, and [representing a group of local government officials](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=5122a5cb8f&e=7017cc100e) who sought to overturn a California law prohibiting public employers from deterring unionization.

**Weiss Represented High-Light Electric In A Lawsuit Brought By The Trustees Of The IBEW Declarations of Trust Alleging That High-Light Violated Collective Bargaining Agreements And Violated ERISA**
* In 2009, Jason Weiss represented High-Light Electric in a lawsuit brought by The Trustees Of The IBEW Declarations of Trust alleging that High-Light withheld payments owed to IBEW members in violation of their collective bargaining agreement and violated ERISA. [[US District Court for the Central District of California, Case #5:09cv1903, 10/9/09; US Department of Labor ]](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=044142a521&e=7017cc100e)

**Weiss Represented Alorica In A Class Action Wage Theft Lawsuit That Settled For $9.25 Million**
_“Alorica ‘Created A Company-wide Pay Roll Scheme Whereby It Treats Any Break In Time Of Less Than Twenty Minutes As Uncompensated Time, Regardless Of The Reason For The Break In Time In The Customer Service Representative’s Login/logout Data,’ A ‘Direct Violation’ Of Rest Time Standards Set By The Fair Labor Standards Act.”_
* From 2013-2016, Jason Weiss represented Alorica, Inc. in a class action alleging that the company had implemented a [company-wide wage theft scheme](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=50c04948d0&e=7017cc100e) to deprive employees of federally required rest breaks and to steal their earned wages. .
* According to to the plaintiff’s complaint, Alorica ‘created a company-wide pay roll scheme whereby it treats any break in time of less than twenty minutes as uncompensated time, regardless of the reason for the break in time in the customer service representative’s login/logout data,’ a ‘direct violation’ of rest time standards set by The Fair Labor Standards Act.
* Alorica [agreed ](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=33e1100737&e=7017cc100e)to pay $9.25 million in the settlement, with up to 120,000 individuals covered by the class.
* This representation is consistent with Sheppard Mullin’s broader defense of wage theft by big corporations. [As the law firm itself boasted](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=4cf69fe437&e=7017cc100e), Sheppard Mullin is “the preeminent employment law firm and subject-matter expert on wage and hour issues,” and was recently retained by employer advocacy groups to draft an amicus brief in support of Home Depot’s efforts to overturn existing law and allow “wage rounding,” a form of wage theft in which employees are “rounded” to the nearest 15 minute increment, rather than their actual time worked.

### _California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Katie Porter is vacating the seat to run for U.S. Senate. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country. _

body:
|
#
Aloha Peter, I know your inbox is crowded with political emails right now _(and so is mine!)_ so I’ll make this short and tell you three important things you need to know:
* There is going to be a record amount of outside spending in the 2024 elections. GOP-aligned Super PACs and special interest groups are expected to spend hundreds of billions of dollars misleading voters about Democrats and propping up Mitch McConnell’s handpicked anti-abortion extremists.

* In the 2022 midterm elections, mainland billionaires spent over $1.4 million in an attempt to buy a Congressional seat in Hawaii — an unprecedented amount for our state. And since Republicans need to flip just _one seat_ to retake the Senate majority, we can’t take any seat for granted — **including mine**. If we’re going to win, we need the resources to respond to unannounced attack ads at any given moment.

* I rely on grassroots donations to sustain my re-election campaign. While Mitch McConnell can turn to his rolodex of right-wing megadonors any time he needs it, I count on the support of folks like you, who pitch in $5 or $10 through emails like this one. _And I wouldn’t change a thing about it._

Peter,

AIPAC attacked some of our Justice Democrats incumbents on Twitter last

They are the NRA of foreign policy. Of course they don’t want a ceasefire.

This pro-war, anti-Palestinian lobby group uses GOP, millionaire, and

enabling the death and destruction of Palestinians all on the U.S.
taxpayer’s dime.

body:
Peter,
The nation was rocked last week by a ruling from the Alabama Supreme Court that frozen embryos should be considered children, resulting in the closure of in vitro fertilization (IVF) clinics across the state.
**But now, women in Texas and elsewhere fear that IVF is the next target for anti-abortion Republicans.**
Following the decision, Amanda Zurawski, who is suing her home state of Texas after she was denied an abortion during her life-threatening labor, has decided to move her frozen embryos out of Texas. And who could blame her?
Texas has always been ground zero for attacks on abortion and reproductive rights. Texas passed one of the most extreme abortion bans in the nation, and they’re not stopping there.
**In fact, SEVENTEEN U.S. House Republicans from Texas have co-sponsored the _Life at Conception Act_ , which would end IVF and other fertility treatments entirely.**
Texas Republicans won’t stop until they criminalize abortion, end IVF, and put conservative judges in charge of Texans’ reproductive decisions. We MUST fight back against this assault on abortion rights and reproductive freedom.
